Yí fàngjià jiù dàizhe háizi qù hǎibiān diàoyú, qù shānshàng zhāi shuǐguǒ, yě kāishǐ zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng qǐ huā lái le. Dāng kāihuā de jìjié dào le, jiārén jiù huì zài yuànzi lǐ kànkan huā, liáoliao tiān. Shàng ge xīngqī tā de yuètuán bàn le yì chǎng hùwài yǎnchànghuì, hǎo duō rén dōu qù kàn tāmen de biǎoyǎn, jiéshù shí hái fàng le yānhuǒ, rènào de bùdéliǎo.
paragraphs.english: From that day on, he tried to recover hobbies from his youth, taking up audio gear and joining a band. On holidays he took his children fishing by the sea and fruit-picking on the mountain, and started planting flowers in the yard. When blooming season arrived, the family would enjoy the flowers and chat in the yard. Last week his band held an outdoor concert, crowds came to watch, and fireworks went off at the finale—it was lively beyond words.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 過去張文華滿腦子都是工作，現在下班時間快到時，就趕快把必要的工作完成，馬上離開辦公室。對他來說，生活的意義不再只是工作，「休息是為了走更遠的路」，努力往前走時，也要停下來看看周圍美麗的風景。
paragraphs.simplified: 过去张文华满脑子都是工作，现在下班时间快到时，就赶快把必要的工作完成，马上离开办公室。对他来说，生活的意义不再只是工作，「休息是为了走更远的路」，努力往前走时，也要停下来看看周围美丽的风景。
paragraphs.pinyin: Guòqù Zhāng Wénhuá mǎnnǎozǐ dōu shì gōngzuò, xiànzài xiàbān shíjiān kuài dào shí, jiù gǎnkuài bǎ bìyào de gōngzuò wánchéng, mǎshàng líkāi bàngōngshì. Duì tā lái shuō, shēnghuó de yìyì bú zài zhǐshì gōngzuò, 'xiūxi shì wèile zǒu gèng yuǎn de lù', nǔlì wǎng qián zǒu shí, yě yào tíng xiàlai kànkan zhōuwéi měilì de fēngjǐng.
paragraphs.english: In the past Zhang Wenhua's head was full of work; now when off-work time nears, he quickly finishes essential tasks and leaves the office immediately. To him, life's meaning is no longer just work: 'rest is for walking a longer road'; while striving forward, one must also pause to take in the beautiful scenery around.

items.title: 對話 · 走吧！當背包客去 · Backpacker's Travel
items.setting: 明哲和東賢在聊東賢的姊姊 · Mingzhe and Dongxian chatting about Dongxian's sister

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 東賢，你姊姊是不是又計畫去旅行了？
paragraphs.simplified: 东贤，你姊姊是不是又计划去旅行了？
paragraphs.pinyin: Dōngxián, nǐ jiějie shì bú shì yòu jìhuà qù lǚxíng le?
paragraphs.english: Dongxian, is your older sister planning another trip again?

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 沒錯。她正準備去非洲大草原。
paragraphs.simplified: 没错。她正准备去非洲大草原。
paragraphs.pinyin: Méicuò. Tā zhèng zhǔnbèi qù Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán.
paragraphs.english: That's right. She's just getting ready to go to the African savanna.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 我常看她部落格裡的背包客日記，不但內容充實、想法獨特，而且跟旅遊相關的建議也寫得很詳細，讓我打開了視野。
paragraphs.simplified: 我常看她部落格里的背包客日记，不但内容充实、想法独特，而且跟旅游相关的建议也写得很详细，让我打开了视野。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ cháng kàn tā bùluògé lǐ de bēibāokè rìjì, búdàn nèiróng chōngshí, xiǎngfǎ dútè, érqiě gēn lǚyóu xiāngguān de jiànyì yě xiě de hěn xiángxì, ràng wǒ dǎkāi le shìyě.
paragraphs.english: I often read the backpacker diary on her blog. Not only is the content substantial and original, but the travel tips are written in great detail, which broadened my horizons.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 我姊姊真的很厲害，一個人上山下海到處旅行。數一數，她已經去過三十幾個國家了。因為她的關係，我也對旅行產生了興趣，上個月她來臺灣時，我們還一起騎自行車環島呢！
paragraphs.simplified: 我姊姊真的很厉害，一个人上山下海到处旅行。数一数，她已经去过三十几个国家了。因为她的关系，我也对旅行产生了兴趣，上个月她来台湾时，我们还一起骑自行车环岛呢！
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zhēnde hěn lìhai, yì ge rén shàngshān xiàhǎi dàochù lǚxíng. Shǔ yì shǔ, tā yǐjīng qù guò sānshí jǐ ge guójiā le. Yīnwèi tā de guānxì, wǒ yě duì lǚxíng chǎnshēng le xìngqù, shàng ge yuè tā lái Táiwān shí, wǒmen hái yìqǐ qí zìxíngchē huándǎo ne!
paragraphs.english: My sister is truly amazing, traveling everywhere by herself from mountains to seas. Counting them up, she's visited over thirty countries. Because of her, I also got interested in travel; when she came to Taiwan last month, we even cycled around the island together!

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 真好。我猜，這次的環島旅行一定讓你姊姊很難忘吧？
paragraphs.simplified: 真好。我猜，这次的环岛旅行一定让你姊姊很难忘吧？
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo. Wǒ cāi, zhè cì de huándǎo lǚxíng yídìng ràng nǐ jiějie hěn nánwàng ba?
paragraphs.english: How wonderful. I bet this island-cycling trip was unforgettable for your sister?

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 唉，怎麼說呢？我們本來計畫旅行十天，可惜才六天就結束了。
paragraphs.simplified: 唉，怎么说呢？我们本来计划旅行十天，可惜才六天就结束了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Ài, zěnme shuō ne? Wǒmen běnlái jìhuà lǚxíng shí tiān, kěxī cái liù tiān jiù jiéshù le.
paragraphs.english: Well, how should I put it? We originally planned a 10-day trip, but unfortunately it ended after just 6 days.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 怎麼回事？
paragraphs.simplified: 怎么回事？
paragraphs.pinyin: Zěnme huí shì?
paragraphs.english: What happened?

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 我們的運氣很差，碰到了壞天氣。出發前，氣象預報說那幾天都是晴天。頭幾天的天氣很好，誰知道到了第六天，一到山區天空就突然變黑，也下起了大雨，我的衣服都濕了，自行車也壞了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我们的运气很差，碰到了坏天气。出发前，气象预报说那几天都是晴天。头几天的天气很好，谁知道到了第六天，一到山区天空就突然变黑，也下起了大雨，我的衣服都湿了，自行车也坏了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒmen de yùnqì hěn chà, pèngdào le huài tiānqì. Chūfā qián, qìxiàng yùbào shuō nà jǐ tiān dōu shì qíngtiān. Tóu jǐ tiān de tiānqì hěn hǎo, shéi zhīdào dào le dì-liù tiān, yí dào shānqū tiānkōng jiù tūrán biàn hēi, yě xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒ de yīfu dōu shī le, zìxíngchē yě huài le.
paragraphs.english: Our luck was terrible; we ran into bad weather. Before leaving, the weather forecast said those days would all be sunny. The first few days were great, but on the sixth day, as soon as we hit the mountains the sky turned black and heavy rain poured down. My clothes were soaked and my bike broke down.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 那真糟糕！不過山區的天氣本來變化就很大，有時山下還是晴天，山上已經變涼，甚至起風、下雨了。後來你們怎麼辦？
paragraphs.simplified: 那真糟糕！不过山区的天气本来变化就很大，有时山下还是晴天，山上已经变凉，甚至起风、下雨了。后来你们怎么办？
paragraphs.pinyin: Nà zhēn zāogāo! Búguò shānqū de tiānqì běnlái biànhuà jiù hěn dà, yǒushí shānxià háishì qíngtiān, shānshàng yǐjīng biàn liáng, shènzhì qǐfēng, xiàyǔ le. Hòulái nǐmen zěnme bàn?
paragraphs.english: That's awful! But mountain weather changes a lot naturally; sometimes it's still sunny at the foot of the mountain while cool, windy, or rainy up top. What did you do then?

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 那時，我們的手機訊號很弱，一直連絡不到能修理的人，只好推著自行車走了很長的一段路。
paragraphs.simplified: 那时，我们的手机讯号很弱，一直连络不到能修理的人，只好推着自行车走了很长的一段路。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nà shí, wǒmen de shǒujī xùnhào hěn ruò, yìzhí liánluò bú dào néng xiūlǐ de rén, zhǐhǎo tuī zhe zìxíngchē zǒu le hěn cháng de yí duàn lù.
paragraphs.english: Back then our cell reception was very weak and we couldn't reach anyone to repair it, so we had no choice but to push the bikes along a long stretch of road.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 附近沒有商店嗎？有沒有車子經過？
paragraphs.simplified: 附近没有商店吗？有没有车子经过？
paragraphs.pinyin: Fùjìn méiyǒu shāngdiàn ma? Yǒu méiyǒu chēzi jīngguò?
paragraphs.english: Were there no shops nearby? Did any cars pass by?

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 那是在偏僻的山區，附近什麼都沒有。還好後來遇到一個當地人，他幫我們把車修好。沒想到那時候我姊姊突然發燒了，我們不得不縮短行程，趕快下山去醫院。
paragraphs.simplified: 那是在偏僻的山区，附近什么都没有。还好后来遇到一个当地人，他帮我们把车修好。没想到那时候我姊姊突然发烧了，我们不得不缩短行程，赶快下山去医院。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nà shì zài piānpì de shānqū, fùjìn shénme dōu méiyǒu. Hái hǎo hòulái yùdào yí ge dāngdì rén, tā bāng wǒmen bǎ chē xiū hǎo. Méi xiǎngdào nà shíhou wǒ jiějie tūrán fāshāo le, wǒmen bùdébù suōduǎn xíngchéng, gǎnkuài xiàshān qù yīyuàn.
paragraphs.english: It was in a remote mountain area with nothing around. Fortunately we ran into a local who fixed our bike. Little did we expect my sister suddenly ran a fever, so we had to cut the trip short and hurry down the mountain to the hospital.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 聽起來這次的旅行不太順利。不過話說回來，就是因為不確定會碰到什麼，所以旅行才這麼迷人。
paragraphs.simplified: 听起来这次的旅行不太顺利。不过话说回来，就是因为不确定会碰到什么，所以旅行才这么迷人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Tīng qǐlai zhè cì de lǚxíng bú tài shùnlì. Búguò huàshuō huílái, jiùshì yīnwèi bú quèdìng huì pèngdào shénme, suǒyǐ lǚxíng cái zhème mírén.
paragraphs.english: Sounds like this trip wasn't very smooth. But then again, it's precisely because you never know what you'll encounter that travel is so enchanting.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 沒錯，我姊姊也是這麼說的。
paragraphs.simplified: 没错，我姊姊也是这么说的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Méicuò, wǒ jiějie yě shì zhème shuō de.
paragraphs.english: Exactly; my sister said so too.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 你姊姊這次去非洲，還是一個人去嗎？有個人陪比較好吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 你姊姊这次去非洲，还是一样一个人去吗？有个人陪比较好吧。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ jiějie zhè cì qù Fēizhōu, háishì yí ge rén qù ma? Yǒu ge rén péi bǐjiào hǎo ba.
paragraphs.english: Is your sister going to Africa by herself again this time? It might be better to have someone accompany her.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 她早就習慣一個人旅行了，想去哪裡就去哪裡，不必在意別人的想法。再說，她的旅行經驗這麼豐富，一個人去絕對沒問題的。像規劃行程、辦簽證，上網查當地的氣溫、地形等等，對她來說，都是小事。
paragraphs.simplified: 她早就习惯一个人旅行了，想去哪里就去哪里，不必在意别人的想法。再说，她的旅行经验这么丰富，一个人去绝对没问题的。像规划行程、办签证，上网查当地的气温、地形等等，对她来说，都是小事。
paragraphs.pinyin: Tā zǎojiù xíguàn yí ge rén lǚxíng le, xiǎng qù nǎlǐ jiù qù nǎlǐ, bú bì zàiyì biérén de xiǎngfǎ. Zàishuō, tā de lǚxíng jīngyàn zhème fēngfù, yí ge rén qù juéduì méi wèntí de. Xiàng guīhuà xíngchéng, bàn qiānzhèng, shàngwǎng chá dāngdì de qìwēn, dìxíng děngděng, duì tā lái shuō, dōu shì xiǎoshì.
paragraphs.english: She's long used to solo travel: going wherever she wants without having to care about others' opinions. Besides, with her rich travel experience, going alone is no problem at all. Planning itineraries, applying for visas, checking weather and terrain online—to her, these are all easy.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 這麼說，不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
paragraphs.simplified: 这么说，不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhème shuō, bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bu chéng de?
paragraphs.english: So that means, wherever she wants to go, there's nowhere she can't make it to?

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊。我姊姊有背包客的性格，她認為只有走出舒服的生活環境，才能發現不一樣的自己。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊。我姊姊有背包客的性格，她认为只有走出舒服的生活环境，才能发现不一样的自己。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì a. Wǒ jiějie yǒu bēibāokè de xìnggé, tā rènwéi zhǐyǒu zǒuchū shūfu de shēnghuó huánjìng, cái néng fāxiàn bù yíyàng de zìjǐ.
paragraphs.english: Yeah. My sister has the spirit of a backpacker; she believes only by stepping out of one's comfort zone can one discover a different self.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 難怪你姊姊的背包客日記，內容總是那麼吸引人。
paragraphs.simplified: 难怪你姊姊的背包客日记，内容总是那么吸引人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ jiějie de bēibāokè rìjì, nèiróng zǒngshì nàme xīyǐnrén.
paragraphs.english: No wonder her backpacker diary is always so captivating.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 對了，你不是剛跟女朋友分開了嗎？要是你因為失戀而覺得很痛苦，就當個背包客出去走走吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 对了，你不是刚跟女朋友分开了吗？要是你因为失恋而觉得很痛苦，就当个背包客出去走走吧。
paragraphs.pinyin: Duì le, nǐ bú shì gāng gēn nǚpéngyou fēnkāi le ma? Yàoshi nǐ yīnwèi shīliàn ér juéde hěn tòngkǔ, jiù dāng ge bēibāokè chūqù zǒuzou ba.
paragraphs.english: By the way, didn't you just break up with your girlfriend? If you're hurting from the heartbreak, why not go on a backpacking trip to clear your head?

items.title: 短文 · 馬丁的環島旅行 · Martin's Round-the-Island Trip
items.setting: 馬丁在臺灣騎車旅行 · Martin cycling around Taiwan

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 馬丁的好兄弟尚恩在臺灣學習中文，他常寄臺灣的明信片給馬丁。明信片上有的是有名的景點，像臺北101、太魯閣、孔廟；有的是臺灣文化的代表，像寺廟、歌仔戲、夜市小吃等等。
paragraphs.simplified: 马丁的好兄弟尚恩在台湾学习中文，他常寄台湾的明信片给马丁。明信片上有的是有名的景点，像台北101、太鲁阁、孔庙；有的是台湾文化的代表，像寺庙、歌仔戏、夜市小吃等等。
paragraphs.pinyin: Mǎdīng de hǎo xiōngdì Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān xuéxí Zhōngwén, tā cháng jì Táiwān de míngxìnpiàn gěi Mǎdīng. Míngxìnpiàn shàng yǒudeshì yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, xiàng Táiběi 101, Tàilǔgé, Kǒngmiào; yǒudeshì Táiwān wénhuà de dàibiǎo, xiàng sìmiào, gēzǎixì, yèshì xiǎochī děngděng.
paragraphs.english: Narrator: Martin's close pal Shawn was studying Chinese in Taiwan and often mailed Taiwan postcards to Martin. Some depicted famous attractions like Taipei 101, Taroko Gorge, and the Confucius Temple; others represented Taiwanese culture, such as temples, Taiwanese opera, and night market snacks.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 馬丁常聽尚恩提到跟臺灣相關的事。比如，臺灣曾經是荷蘭和日本等國家的殖民地；臺灣人和中國人都說中文，可是有一些詞的用法不太一樣；就選舉文化來說，臺灣和法國很不同，不過願意服務民眾的人，都比較容易當選。
paragraphs.simplified: 马丁常听尚恩提到跟台湾相关的事。比如，台湾曾经是荷兰和日本等国家的殖民地；台湾人和中国人都说中文，可是有一些词的用法不太一样；就选举文化来说，台湾和法国很不同，不过愿意服务民众的人，都比较容易当选。
paragraphs.pinyin: Mǎdīng cháng tīng Shàng'ēn tídào gēn Táiwān xiāngguān de shì. Bǐrú, Táiwān céngjīng shì Hélán hé Rìběn děng guójiā de zhímíndì; Táiwānrén hé Zhōngguórén dōu shuō Zhōngwén, kěshì yǒu yìxiē cí de yòngfǎ bú tài yíyàng; jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, Táiwān hé Fǎguó hěn bù tóng, búguò yuànyì fúwù mínzhòng de rén, dōu bǐjiào róngyì dāngxuǎn.
paragraphs.english: Martin often heard Shawn mention matters regarding Taiwan. For example, Taiwan had once been a colony of the Netherlands and Japan; both Taiwanese and mainland Chinese speak Chinese, but certain word usages differ; in terms of election culture, Taiwan and France are very different, though those willing to serve the public are more likely to get elected.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 馬丁覺得尚恩在臺灣的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要親自來確認一下，看看這個島是不是真的像尚恩說的那樣有意思。最近馬丁的工作不太順利，所以他決定給自己放個假，到離法國約一萬公里以外的臺灣走走。不僅要嚐嚐小吃，還計畫一個人騎自行車環島旅行。
paragraphs.simplified: 马丁觉得尚恩在台湾的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要亲自来确认一下，看看这个岛是不是真的像尚恩说的那样有意思。最近马丁的工作不太顺利，所以他决定给自己放个假，到离法国约一万公里以外的台湾走走。不仅要尝尝小吃，还计划一个人骑自行车环岛旅行。
paragraphs.pinyin: Mǎdīng juéde Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān de shēnghuó hěn yǒu yìsi, tā xiǎng, yǒu yì tiān yídìng yào qīnzì lái quèrèn yíxià, kànkan zhè ge dǎo shì bú shì zhēnde xiàng Shàng'ēn shuō de nàyàng yǒu yìsi. Zuìjìn Mǎdīng de gōngzuò bú tài shùnlì, suǒyǐ tā juédìng gěi zìjǐ fàng ge jià, dào lí Fǎguó yuē yí wàn gōnglǐ yǐwài de Táiwān zǒuzou. Bùjǐn yào chángchang xiǎochī, hái jìhuà yí ge rén qí zìxíngchē huándǎo lǚxíng.
paragraphs.english: Martin found Shawn's life in Taiwan fascinating and felt that one day he must come personally verify if this island was really as intriguing as Shawn described. Recently Martin's work wasn't going smoothly, so he decided to take a holiday and visit Taiwan, some 10,000 kilometers away from France. He planned not only to taste local snacks, but also to cycle around the island alone.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 其實馬丁剛到臺灣時，還忘不了工作的問題，所以心情不太好。但是，當他在東部又寬又平的公路上，邊騎著自行車，邊欣賞美麗的風景時，他忽然覺得就像在天堂一樣，太美好、太值得了！還有一次，馬丁坐在椅子上，很專心地看著寺廟前的歌仔戲表演。演員演出時，剛好穿著和明信片上一樣的服裝，那種熟悉的感覺讓他很興奮，立刻拿起相機拍了起來。這段時間他也認識了一些樂觀、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、開玩笑，讓他開心得把工作的問題都忘了。馬丁覺得在臺灣經驗過的這些美好生活，就是這次旅行最珍貴的紀念。
paragraphs.simplified: 其实马丁刚到台湾时，还忘不了工作的问题，所以心情不太好。但是，当他在东部又宽又平的公路上，边骑着自行车，边欣赏美丽的风景时，他忽然觉得就像在天堂一样，太美好、太值得了！还有一次，马丁坐在椅子上，很专心地看着寺庙前的歌仔戏表演。演员演出时，刚好穿着和明信片上一样的服装，那种熟悉的感觉让他很兴奋，立刻拿起相机拍了起来。这段时间他也认识了一些乐观、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、开玩笑，让他开心得把工作的问题都忘了。马丁觉得在台湾经验过的这些美好生活，就是这次旅行最珍贵的纪念。
paragraphs.pinyin: Qíshí Mǎdīng gāng dào Táiwān shí, hái wàng buliǎo gōngzuò de wèntí, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bú tài hǎo. Dànshì, dāng tā zài dōngbù yòu kuān yòu píng de gōnglù shàng, biān qí zhe zìxíngchē, biān xīnshǎng měilì de fēngjǐng shí, tā hūrán juéde jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yíyàng, tài měihǎo, tài zhídé le! Hái yǒu yí cì, Mǎdīng zuò zài yǐzi shàng, hěn zhuānxīn de kàn zhe sìmiào qián de gēzǎixì biǎoyǎn. Yǎnyuán yǎnchū shí, gānghǎo chuān zhe hé míngxìnpiàn shàng yíyàng de fúzhuāng, nà zhǒng shóuxī de gǎnjué ràng tā hěn xīngfèn, lìkè ná qǐ xiàngjī pāi le qǐlai. Zhè duàn shíjiān tā yě rènshí le yìxiē lèguān, yōumò de péngyou, dàjiā yìqǐ liáotiān, kāiwánxiào, ràng tā kāixīn de bǎ gōngzuò de wèntí dōu wàng le. Mǎdīng juéde zài Táiwān jīngyàn guò de zhèxiē měihǎo shēnghuó, jiùshì zhè cì lǚxíng zuì zhēnguì de jìniàn.
paragraphs.english: Actually when Martin first arrived, he couldn't put work troubles out of mind and was in a low mood. But as he cycled along wide flat highways in eastern Taiwan while admiring the breathtaking scenery, he suddenly felt like he was in paradise—it was wonderful and so worthwhile! Another time, sitting on a chair, he watched a Taiwanese opera performance in front of a temple attentively. The actors were dressed in the exact costumes shown on the postcards; that familiar feeling thrilled him, and he immediately snapped photos. During this trip he also befriended optimistic, humorous companions whose chats and jokes made him forget his work stress. Martin felt these wonderful experiences were the most precious souvenirs of the trip.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 經過這趟豐富的旅行後，馬丁的心情好多了，想法也改變了。回到法國後，到底要換新工作，還是要克服困難勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳選擇，讓生活過得更充實、更有意義。
paragraphs.simplified: 经过这趟丰富的旅行后，马丁的心情好多了，想法也改变了。回到法国后，到底要换新工作，还是要克服困难勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳选择，让生活过得更充实、更有意义。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè tàng fēngfù de lǚxíng hòu, Mǎdīng de xīnqíng hǎo duō le, xiǎngfǎ yě gǎibiàn le. Huí dào Fǎguó hòu, dàodǐ yào huàn xīn gōngzuò, háishì yào kèfú kùnnan yǒnggǎn zǒu xiàqu, tā xiāngxìn zìjǐ yídìng néng zuòchū zuìjiā xuǎnzé, ràng shēnghuó guò de gèng chōngshí, gèng yǒu yìyì.
paragraphs.english: After this enriching journey, Martin felt much better and his outlook shifted. Upon returning to France, whether to switch jobs or face difficulties bravely, he was confident he could make the best choice to make his life more fulfilling and meaningful.

items.title: 穿著和品味

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 朋子，妳最近穿衣服的風格跟以前很不一樣，名牌衣服怎麼不穿了呢？
paragraphs.simplified: 朋子，你最近穿衣服的风格跟以前很不一样，名牌衣服怎么不穿了呢？
paragraphs.pinyin: Péngzǐ, nǐ zuìjìn chuān yīfú de fēnggé gēn yǐqián hěn bù yíyàng, míngpái yīfú zěnme bù chuān le ne?
paragraphs.english: Tomoko, your clothing style lately is very different from before. How come you don't wear brand-name clothes anymore?

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 我想改變別人對我的看法。以前，我的穿著容易讓人產生誤會，以為我是個不好相處的人。
paragraphs.simplified: 我想改变别人对我的看法。以前，我的穿着容易让人产生误会，以为我是个不好相处的人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gǎibiàn biérén duì wǒ de kànfǎ. Yǐqián, wǒ de chuānzhuó róngyì ràng rén chǎnshēng wùhuì, yǐwéi wǒ shì ge bù hǎo xiāngchǔ de rén.
paragraphs.english: I want to change what people think of me. In the past, my dressing easily gave people misunderstandings, assuming I was hard to get along with.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 說真的，剛認識妳的時候，妳從頭到腳都是名牌，總是覺得我們有一段距離。
paragraphs.simplified: 说真的，刚认识你的时候，你从头到脚都是名牌，总是觉得我们有一段距离。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shuō zhēn de, gāng rènshì nǐ de shíhòu, nǐ cóng tóu dào jiǎo dōushì míngpái, zǒngshì juéde wǒmen yǒu yí duàn jùlí.
paragraphs.english: Honestly, when I first met you, you wore designer labels from head to toe, and I always felt a distance between us.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 唉！不用說也知道你會這麼想。其實這跟我爸媽有關，他們對穿衣服很講究，也覺得穿名牌才有品味，所以影響了我對穿著的看法。
paragraphs.simplified: 唉！不用说也知道你会这么想。其实这跟我爸妈有关，他们对穿衣服很讲究，也觉得穿名牌才有品味，所以影响了我对穿着的看法。
paragraphs.pinyin: Ài! Búyòng shuō yě zhīdào nǐ huì zhème xiǎng. Qíshí zhè gēn wǒ bàmā yǒuguān, tāmen duì chuān yīfú hěn jiǎngjiù, yě juéde chuān míngpái cái yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ yǐngxiǎng le wǒ duì chuānzhuó de kànfǎ.
paragraphs.english: Sigh! It goes without saying you'd think that. Actually this has to do with my parents; they are very particular about clothing and feel only designer clothes have taste, so that influenced my view on dressing.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 妳爸媽的朋友，不是大老闆就是政治人物，有這樣的想法很自然啊！合適的穿著對他們很重要，名牌衣服才能表現出他們的地位。
paragraphs.simplified: 你爸妈的朋友，不是大老板就是政治人物，有这样的想法很自然啊！合适的人穿着对他们很重要，名牌衣服才能表现出他们的地位。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ bàmā de péngyǒu, búshì dà lǎobǎn jiùshì zhèngzhì rénwù, yǒu zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ hěn zìrán a! Héshì de chuānzhuó duì tāmen hěn zhòngyào, míngpái yīfú cái néng biǎoxiàn chū tāmen de dìwèi.
paragraphs.english: Your parents' friends are either big bosses or political figures, so having that mindset is quite natural! Appropriate attire is very important for them; designer clothing expresses their status.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 你說的沒錯，可是我還是不希望大家把我看成只愛買名牌的人。
paragraphs.simplified: 你说得没错，可是我还是不希望大家把我看成只爱买名牌的人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò, kěshì wǒ háishì bù xīwàng dàjiā bǎ wǒ kànchéng zhǐ ài mǎi míngpái de rén.
paragraphs.english: What you said is true, but I still don't want everyone to look at me as someone who only cares about buying luxury brands.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 跟以前比起來，妳現在的穿著更能表現出個人的特色。
paragraphs.simplified: 跟以前比起来，你现在的穿着更能表现出个人的特色。
paragraphs.pinyin: Gēn yǐqián bǐ qǐlái, nǐ xiànzài de chuānzhuó gèng néng biǎoxiàn chū gèrén de tèsè.
paragraphs.english: Compared to before, your dressing now expresses your personal character much better.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 以前我和朋友聊天的話題，常常是哪些服裝很流行，哪個名牌又請了大明星拍廣告什麼的，現在我只想穿得舒適，又有屬於自己的風格，是不是名牌真的無所謂。
paragraphs.simplified: 以前我和朋友聊天的话题，常常是哪些服装很流行，哪个名牌又请了大明星拍广告什么的，现在我只想穿得舒适，又有属于自己的风格，是不是名牌真的无所谓。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ hé péngyǒu liáotiān de huàtí, chángcháng shì nǎxiē fúzhuāng hěn liúxíng, nǎge míngpái yòu qǐng le dà míngxīng pāi guǎnggào shénmede, xiànzài wǒ zhǐ xiǎng chuān de shūshì, yòu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de fēnggé, shì bú shì míngpái zhēn de wúsuǒwèi.
paragraphs.english: In the past, topics when chatting with friends were often about which clothes were trendy, or which brand hired a celebrity for an ad. Now I just want to dress comfortably and have my own style; whether it's a name brand really doesn't matter.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 一般來說，明星的穿著都會吸引大家注意，所以服裝公司才會花大錢請明星拍廣告，這是正常的商業作法。其實多了解一些流行的現象也沒什麼不好。
paragraphs.simplified: 一般来说，明星的穿着都会吸引大家注意，所以服装公司才会花大钱请明星拍广告，这是正常的商业作法。其实多了解一些流行的现象也没什么不好。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yìbān láishuō, míngxīng de chuānzhuó dōu huì xīyǐn dàjiā zhùyì, suǒyǐ fúzhuāng gōngsī cái huì huā dà qián qǐng míngxīng pāi guǎnggào, zhè shì zhèngcháng de shāngyè zuòfǎ. Qíshí duō liǎojiě yìxiē liúxíng de xiànxiàng yě méi shénme bù hǎo.
paragraphs.english: Generally speaking, celebrities' attire draws attention, so apparel companies spend big money to hire stars for commercials; that's a normal commercial practice. Actually, understanding fashion trends isn't a bad thing either.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 嗯，問題是流行的穿著不一定就有品味，再英俊、再漂亮的人也應該找到自己的風格。
paragraphs.simplified: 嗯，问题是流行的穿着不一定就有品味，再英俊、再漂亮的人也应该找到自己的风格。
paragraphs.pinyin: Èn, wèntí shì liúxíng de chuānzhuó bù yídìng jiù yǒu pǐnwèi, zài yīngjùn, zài piàoliang de rén yě yīnggāi zhǎodào zìjǐ de fēnggé.
paragraphs.english: Mm, the issue is that trendy dressing doesn't necessarily have good taste. No matter how handsome or pretty someone is, they should still find their own style.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 我同意妳的說法。想穿出自己的風格，可以多看看專櫃跟雜誌上流行的服裝，想像穿在自己身上的樣子。過些時間，就能抓到感覺了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我同意你的说法。想穿出自己的风格，可以多看看专柜跟杂志上流行的服装，想象穿在自己身上的样子。过些时间，就能抓到感觉了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ de shuōfǎ. Xiǎng chuān chū zìjǐ de fēnggé, kěyǐ duō kànkan zhuānguì gēn zázhì shàng liúxíng de fúzhuāng, xiǎngxiàng chuān zài zìjǐ shēnshang de yàngzi. Guò xiē shíjiān, jiù néng zhuādào gǎnjué le.
paragraphs.english: I agree with what you said. If you want to dress with personal style, browse department counters and fashion magazines, and imagine what looks good on you. In time, you'll catch the feeling.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 不過也不能只跟著流行，一定要有自己的想法。我有幾個朋友跟我剛好相反，他們不僅天天穿名牌，也常上街買衣服，什麼流行就買什麼，好像花多少錢都沒有限制。
paragraphs.simplified: 不过也不能只跟着流行，一定要有自己的想法。我有几个朋友跟我刚好相反，他们不仅天天穿名牌，也常上街买衣服，什么流行就买什么，好像花多少钱都没有限制。
paragraphs.pinyin: Búguò yě bù néng zhǐ gēnzhe liúxíng, yídìng yào yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge péngyǒu gēn wǒ gānghǎo xiāngfǎn, tāmen bùjǐn tiāntiān chuān míngpái, yě cháng shàngjiē mǎi yīfú, shénme liúxíng jiù mǎi shénme, hǎoxiàng huā duōshao qián dōu méiyǒu xiànzhì.
paragraphs.english: Still, one shouldn't just follow trends; you must have your own perspective. I have a few friends who are the exact opposite of me: not only do they wear designer clothes every day, but they often go shopping, buying whatever is trendy, as if there is no spending limit.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 難怪大家都說女孩子的櫃子裡永遠少一件衣服。
paragraphs.simplified: 难怪大家都说女孩子的柜子里永远少一件衣服。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nánguài dàjiā dōu shuō nǚhái zǐ de guìzi lǐ yǒngyuǎn shǎo yí jiàn yīfú.
paragraphs.english: No wonder everyone says a woman's wardrobe is always missing one piece of clothing.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 我可不是喔！以前，一有新商品我就去買；現在，我了解自己真正的需要是什麼，絕對不會亂買了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我可不是喔！以前，一有新商品我就去买；现在，我了解自己真正的需要是什么，绝对不会乱买了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ kě bú shì ō! Yǐqián, yì yǒu xīn shāngpǐn wǒ jiù qù mǎi; xiànzài, wǒ liǎojiě zìjǐ zhēnzhèng de xūyào shì shénme, juéduì bú huì luàn mǎi le.
paragraphs.english: Not me, though! In the past, as soon as a new product came out I went to buy it; now, I understand what my real needs are, and I definitely won't buy recklessly.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 其實穿衣服也是個學問。名牌衣服，有的人穿起來好看，有的人穿起來可能很醜呢！
paragraphs.simplified: 其实穿衣服也是个学问。名牌衣服，有的人穿起来好看，有的人穿起来可能很丑呢！
paragraphs.pinyin: Qíshí chuān yīfú yě shì ge xuéwèn. Míngpái yīfú, yǒu de rén chuān qǐlái hǎokàn, yǒu de rén chuān qǐlái kěnéng hěn chǒu ne!
paragraphs.english: Actually, dressing well is a skill in itself. Brand-name clothes look great on some people, but on others they can look quite ugly!

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 沒錯。對我來說，只要穿得慣、穿得自在，把自己當衣服的主人，這樣就能對自己更有信心了。
paragraphs.simplified: 没错。对我来说，只要穿得惯、穿得自在，把自己当衣服的主人，这样就能对自己更有信心了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Méicuò. Duì wǒ láishuō, zhǐyào chuān de guàn, chuān de zìzài, bǎ zìjǐ dāng yīfú de zhǔrén, zhèyàng jiù néng duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn le.
paragraphs.english: Exactly. To me, as long as I feel accustomed and at ease wearing them, treating myself as the master of the clothes, that's how I gain more self-confidence.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 妳本來條件就好，加上穿著又變得這麼有品味，難怪越來越有魅力了。
paragraphs.simplified: 你本来条件就好，加上穿着又变得这么有品味，难怪越来越有魅力了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ běnlái tiáojiàn jiù hǎo, jiāshàng chuānzhuó yòu biànde zhème yǒu pǐnwèi, nánguài yuèláiyuè yǒu mèilì le.
paragraphs.english: You naturally have great qualities, and now that your attire has become so tasteful, no wonder you're growing more charming by the day.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 別開玩笑了，你的品味比我更好呢！
paragraphs.simplified: 别开玩笑了，你的品味比我更好呢！
paragraphs.pinyin: Bié kāi wánxiào le, nǐ de pǐnwèi bǐ wǒ gèng hǎo ne!
paragraphs.english: Stop joking, your taste is even better than mine!

items.title: 快時尚

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 東賢以前是模特兒，他曾經和一家服裝公司合作，為推銷新產品拍廣告。廣告播出以後，商品賣得非常好。但是，過不了多久，就有樣式更新、更吸引人的服裝出來了。這種「快時尚」的現象，對民眾的生活產生了很大的影響。
paragraphs.simplified: 东贤以前是模特儿，他曾经和一家服装公司合作，为推销新产品拍广告。广告播出以后，商品卖得非常好。但是，过不了多久，就有样式更新、更吸引人的服装出来了。这种「快时尚」的现象，对民众的生活产生了很大的影响。
paragraphs.pinyin: Dōngxián yǐqián shì mótèr, tā céngjīng hé yì jiā fúzhuāng gōngsī hézuò, wèi tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn pāi guǎnggào. Guǎnggào bōchū yǐhòu, shāngpǐn mài de fēicháng hǎo. Dànshì, guò bù liǎo duōjiǔ, jiù yǒu yàngshì gèng xīn, gèng xīyǐn rén de fúzhuāng chūlái le. Zhè zhǒng "kuàishíshàng" de xiànxiàng, duì mínzhòng de shēnghuó chǎnshēng le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
paragraphs.english: Dongxian was formerly a model; he once collaborated with an apparel firm to film commercials for new product promotions. After the commercial aired, products sold extremely well. However, before long, newer and more attractive styles came out. This phenomenon of fast fashion has profoundly impacted everyday life.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 所謂「快時尚」，意思是服裝公司掌握最新流行的方向，很快把服裝設計、生產出來，讓顧客能趕上流行，也能擁有平價的時尚商品。不過，流行的變化速度太快，越來越多新衣服還沒穿就被丟掉，讓人們不能不思考這樣的時尚有沒有意義。
paragraphs.simplified: 所谓「快时尚」，意思是服装公司掌握最新流行的方向，很快把服装设计、生产出来，让顾客能赶上流行，也能拥有平价的时尚商品。不过，流行的变化速度太快，越来越多新衣服还没穿就被丢掉，让人们不能不思考这样的时尚有没有意义。
paragraphs.pinyin: Suǒwèi "kuàishíshàng", yìsi shì fúzhuāng gōngsī zhǎngwò zuìxīn liúxíng de fāngxiàng, hěn kuài bǎ fúzhuāng shèjì, shēngchǎn chūlái, ràng gùkè néng gǎnshàng liúxíng, yě néng yǒngyǒu píngjià de shíshàng shāngpǐn. Búguò, liúxíng de biànhuà sùdù tài kuài, yuèláiyuè duō xīn yīfú hái méi chuān jiù bèi diūdiào, ràng rénmen bù néng bù sīkǎo zhèyàng de shíshàng yǒu méiyǒu yìyì.
paragraphs.english: The so-called fast fashion means apparel companies capture the latest fashion trends and quickly design and manufacture clothes, allowing customers to catch up with trends while owning affordable fashion items. However, fashion trends change so quickly that more and more new clothes are thrown out before being worn, forcing people to reconsider if such fashion holds real meaning.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 因為工作的需求，東賢的衣櫃裡掛著各式各樣的「快時尚」服裝。平時他不覺得有什麼問題，等到搬家時，才發現衣服這麼多，處理起來真的很麻煩。有的連一次也沒穿過，可是已經不流行了，到底要留下來、送人還是丟掉，讓東賢相當頭痛。他不得不承認，「快時尚」也是有壞處的。
paragraphs.simplified: 因为工作的需求，东贤的衣柜里挂着各式各样的「快时尚」服装。平时他不觉得有什么问题，等到搬家时，才发现衣服这么多，处理起来真的很麻烦。有的连一次也没穿过，可是已经不流行了，到底要留下来、送人还是丢掉，让东贤相当头痛。他不得不承认，「快时尚」也是有坏处的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de xūqiú, Dōngxián de yīguì lǐ guàzhe gèshì gèyàng de "kuàishíshàng" fúzhuāng. Píngshí tā bù juéde yǒu shénme wèntí, děng dào bānjiā shí, cái fāxiàn yīfú zhème duō, chǔlǐ qǐlái zhēn de hěn máfan. Yǒude lián yí cì yě méi chuān guo, kěshì yǐjīng bù liúxíng le, dàodǐ yào liú xiàlái, sòng rén háishì diūdiào, ràng Dōngxián xiāngdāng tóutòng. Tā bùdébù chéngrèn, "kuàishíshàng" yě shì yǒu huàichù de.
paragraphs.english: Due to job needs, Dongxian's closet was hung with all kinds of fast-fashion garments. Ordinarily he felt no issue, but when moving, he realized there were so many clothes and sorting them out was genuinely troublesome. Some hadn't even been worn once, yet were already out of style; whether to keep, gift, or toss them gave Dongxian a huge headache. He had to admit that fast fashion also brings harms.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 過去，東賢對穿著不太有自信，也很擔心跟不上流行，所以才不斷地追求時尚。現在，他比較冷靜了，他要當衣服的主人，不再為了趕流行亂買衣服。況且把舊衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有個性、很有品味，所以在東賢心中，沒有什麼是非買不可的。畢竟「快時尚」只是一時的流行，長得再帥、再漂亮的人，也應該找出屬於自己最合適的穿著，這樣才是正確的選擇。
paragraphs.simplified: 过去，东贤对穿着不太有自信，也很担心跟不上流行，所以才不断地追求时尚。现在，他比较冷静了，他要当衣服的主人，不再为了赶流行乱买衣服。况且把旧衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有个性、很有品味，所以在东贤心中，没有什么是非买不可的。毕竟「快时尚」只是一时的流行，长得再帅、再漂亮的人，也应该找出属于自己最合适的人穿着，这样才是正确的选择。
paragraphs.pinyin: Guòqù, Dōngxián duì chuānzhuó bú tài yǒu zìxìn, yě hěn dānxīn gēnbushàng liúxíng, suǒyǐ cái búduàn de zhuīqiú shíshàng. Xiànzài, tā bǐjiào lěngjìng le, tā yào dāng yīfú de zhǔrén, bú zài wèile gǎn liúxíng luàn mǎi yīfú. Kuàngqiě bǎ jiù yīfú xiūgǎi yíxià, yě néng shǐ zìjǐ chuān de hěn gèxìng, hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ zài Dōngxián xīnzhōng, méiyǒu shénme shì fēi mǎi bù kě de. Bìjìng "kuàishíshàng" zhǐ shì yìshí de liúxíng, zhǎng de zài shuài, zài piàoliang de rén, yě yīnggāi zhǎochū shǔyú zìjǐ zuì héshì de chuānzhuó, zhèyàng cái shì zhèngquè de xuǎnzé.
paragraphs.english: In the past, Dongxian lacked confidence in dressing and constantly feared falling behind trends, which drove him to chase fashion non-stop. Now he has calmed down; he wants to be the master of clothes and no longer buys thoughtlessly to chase fads. Moreover, modifying old clothes can also allow one to dress with distinction and taste, so in his mind, nothing is an absolute must-buy. After all, fast fashion is merely a temporary fad; no matter how handsome or pretty one is, finding the attire that truly suits oneself is the right choice.

items.title: 誰說得念大學才有未來？

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 恭喜你弟弟參加網球比賽得到了第一名。好久沒看到他了，他最近怎麼樣？
paragraphs.simplified: 恭喜你弟弟参加网球比赛得到了第一名。好久没看到他了，他最近怎么样？
paragraphs.pinyin: Gōngxǐ nǐ dìdi cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài dédào le dì-yī míng. Hǎojiǔ méi kàndào tā le, tā zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?
paragraphs.english: Congratulations on your younger brother taking first place in the tennis tournament! I haven't seen him in a while; how has he been lately?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 他忙著準備今年的大學考試，總是睡得不太安心，半夜會突然醒過來。
paragraphs.simplified: 他忙着准备今年的大学考试，总是睡得不太安心，半夜会突然醒过来。
paragraphs.pinyin: Tā mángzhe zhǔnbèi jīnnián de dàxué kǎoshì, zǒngshì shuì de bú tài ānxīn, bànyè huì tūrán xǐng guòlái.
paragraphs.english: He's busy preparing for this year's college entrance exams. He never sleeps restfully and often wakes up suddenly in the middle of the night.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 記得你說過，你弟弟學習和運動的表現都很好。我想只要心情放輕鬆就沒問題了。
paragraphs.simplified: 记得你说过，你弟弟学习和运动的表现都很好。我想只要心情放轻松就没问题了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jìde nǐ shuō guo, nǐ dìdi xuéxí hé yùndòng de biǎoxiàn dōu hěn hǎo. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào xīnqíng fàng qīngsōng jiù méi wèntí le.
paragraphs.english: I remember you said your brother performs well in both academics and sports. I think as long as he relaxes his mindset, he'll do fine.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 問題是，我爸媽希望他能考上前三名的大學，不是打球得第一，要求他把全部的時間都拿來準備考試。可是我弟弟覺得打球不會影響他念書，他們還因為這件事吵了一架。
paragraphs.simplified: 问题是，我爸妈希望他能考上前三名的大学，不是打球得第一，要求他把全部的时间都拿来准备考试。可是我弟弟觉得打球不会影响他念书，他们还因为这件事吵了一架。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wèntí shì, wǒ bàmā xīwàng tā néng kǎoshàng qián sān míng de dàxué, búshì dǎqiú dé dì-yī, yāoqiú tā bǎ quánbù de shíjiān dōu nálái zhǔnbèi kǎoshì. Kěshì wǒ dìdi juéde dǎqiú bú huì yǐngxiǎng tā niànshū, tāmen hái yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì chǎo le yí jià.
paragraphs.english: The problem is that my parents hope he can test into a top-three university rather than placing first in ball games; they demand he devote all his time to exam prep. But my brother believes playing ball won't hurt his studies, and they even had a big argument over this.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 哦？你弟弟的運動成績那麼好，我以為你爸媽會為他高興。
paragraphs.simplified: 哦？你弟弟的运动成绩那么好，我以为你爸妈会为他高兴。
paragraphs.pinyin: Ó? Nǐ dìdi de yùndòng chéngjī nàme hǎo, wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bàmā huì wèi tā gāoxìng.
paragraphs.english: Oh? Your brother's athletic achievements are so stellar; I thought your parents would be thrilled for him.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 他們是很高興，可是現在要考大學，情況就不同了。我曾經有一次，考試前想跟同學去露營，爸媽知道了就罵我：「快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？」不管我怎麼解釋他們都不聽，讓我難過了半天。
paragraphs.simplified: 他们是很高兴，可是现在要考大学，情况就不同了。我曾经有一次，考试前想跟同学去露营，爸妈知道了就骂我：「快考试了，怎么不在家念书，反而想出去玩？」不管我怎么解释他们都不听，让我难过了半天。
paragraphs.pinyin: Tāmen shì hěn gāoxìng, kěshì xiànzài yào kǎo dàxué, qíngkuàng jiù bùtóng le. Wǒ céngjīng yǒu yí cì, kǎoshì qián xiǎng gēn tóngxué qù lùyíng, bàmā zhīdào le jiù mà wǒ: "Kuài kǎoshì le, zěnme bú zài jiā niànshū, fǎn'ér xiǎng chūqù wán?" Bùguǎn wǒ zěnme jiěshì tāmen dōu bù tīng, ràng wǒ nánguò le bàntiān.
paragraphs.english: They are happy, but now that college exams are ahead, the situation is different. Once before an exam, I wanted to go camping with classmates; when my parents found out, they scolded me: 'Exams are around the corner, why aren't you studying at home instead of wanting to go out playing?' No matter how I explained, they wouldn't listen, which made me upset for a long time.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 可是，生命中有很多事情比考試還要重要啊！再說，孩子怎麼受得了一直被逼著念書呢？
paragraphs.simplified: 可是，生命中有很多事情比考试还要重要啊！再说，孩子怎么受得了一直被逼着念书呢？
paragraphs.pinyin: Kěshì, shēngmìng zhōng yǒu hěn duō shìqíng bǐ kǎoshì hái yào zhòngyào a! Zàishuō, háizi zěnme shòudeliǎo yìzhí bèi bīzhe niànshū ne?
paragraphs.english: Still, there are many things in life even more important than exams! Besides, how can any kid stand being forced to study constantly?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 我爸媽才不這麼想。其實有一些高中老師也是這樣，雖然他們也教導學生做人做事的道理，但臺灣社會很重視升學，所以考試就變成教學的重心了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我爸妈才不这么想。其实有一些高中老师也是这样，虽然他们也教导学生做人做事的道理，但台湾社会很重视升学，所以考试就变成教学的重心了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ bàmā cái bù zhème xiǎng. Qíshí yǒu yìxiē gāozhōng lǎoshī yě shì zhèyàng, suīrán tāmen yě jiàodǎo xuéshēng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, dàn Táiwān shèhuì hěn zhòngshì shēngxué, suǒyǐ kǎoshì jiù biànchéng jiàoxué de zhòngxīn le.
paragraphs.english: My parents certainly don't think that way. Actually, some high school teachers are like that too: while they teach life principles, Taiwanese society values college advancement so much that exams become the core focus of teaching.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 難怪你爸媽也認為考試最重要，好像只要考上好大學，將來就能有成就。
paragraphs.simplified: 难怪你爸妈也认为考试最重要，好像只要考上好大学，将来就能有成就。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ bàmā yě rènwéi kǎoshì zuì zhòngyào, hǎoxiàng zhǐyào kǎoshàng hǎo dàxué, jiānglái jiù néng yǒu chéngjiù.
paragraphs.english: No wonder your parents think exams are paramount, as if as long as you get into a good college, you will achieve success in the future.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊，就是因為這樣，所以老師要求學生做一堆測驗題目、記一堆筆記。要是孩子考不及格或學習成果不好，家長就逼孩子去補習，就算孩子再不滿也得去。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊，就是因为这样，所以老师要求学生做一堆测验题目、记一堆笔记。要是孩子考不及格或学习成果不好，家长就逼孩子去补习，就算孩子再不满也得去。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì a, jiùshì yīnwèi zhèyàng, suǒyǐ lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshēng zuò yì duī cèyàn tímù, jì yì duī bǐjì. Yàoshi háizi kǎo bù jígé huò xuéxí chéngguǒ bù hǎo, jiāzhǎng jiù bī háizi qù bǔxí, jiùsuàn háizi zài bùmǎn yě děi qù.
paragraphs.english: Yeah, exactly because of that, teachers demand students do piles of test questions and take heaps of notes. If a child fails or performs poorly, parents force them into cram schools no matter how unhappy they are.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 不過，我聽語言交換的朋友說，現在不少臺灣老師的教學方式變活潑了。他們利用有趣的教材和網路工具，帶領學生吸收新知識，也讓本來沒有自信的學生，願意主動舉手請教老師了。
paragraphs.simplified: 不过，我听语言交换的朋友说，现在不少台湾老师的教学方式变活泼了。他们利用有趣的教材和网路工具，带领学生吸收新知识，也让本来没有自信的学生，愿意主动举手请教老师了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ tīng yǔyán jiāohuàn de péngyǒu shuō, xiànzài bù shǎo Táiwān lǎoshī de jiàoxué fāngshì biàn huópo le. Tāmen lìyòng yǒuqù de jiàocái hé wǎnglù gōngjù, dàilǐng xuéshēng xīshōu xīn zhīshì, yě ràng běnlái méiyǒu zìxìn de xuéshēng, yuànyì zhǔdòng jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī le.
paragraphs.english: However, I heard from language exchange friends that many Taiwanese teachers are adopting livelier methods now. They use engaging materials and online tools to lead students in absorbing knowledge, prompting even unconfident students to raise their hands and consult teachers.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊，不只教學方式變了，升學制度也改了。像有一些學生體育、美術或音樂的成績非常好，就能以特殊表現，選擇理想的大學。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊，不只教学方式变了，升学制度也改了。像有一些学生体育、美术或音乐的成绩非常好，就能以特殊表现，选择理想的大学。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì a, bù zhǐ jiàoxué fāngshì biàn le, shēngxué zhìdù yě gǎi le. Xiàng yǒu yìxiē xuéshēng tǐyù, měishù huò yīnyuè de chéngjī fēicháng hǎo, jiù néng yǐ tèshū biǎoxiàn, xuǎnzé lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
paragraphs.english: Right, not only teaching methods have changed, but college admissions systems have evolved too. Students with exceptional sports, art, or music talents can use their special achievements to enter ideal universities.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 我覺得這樣比較合理。像歐洲就有不少水準很高的職業學校，培養學生的專業能力，將來就比較容易找到工作。
paragraphs.simplified: 我觉得这样比较合理。像欧洲就有不少水准很高的职业学校，培养学生的专业能力，将来就比较容易找到工作。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhèyàng bǐjiào hélǐ. Xiàng Ōuzhōu jiù yǒu bù shǎo shuǐzhǔn hěn gāo de zhíyè xuéxiào, péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì, jiānglái jiù bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào gōngzuò.
paragraphs.english: I think that's far more reasonable. Europe has many high-standard vocational schools cultivating students' technical expertise, making it easier to find jobs.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 我有一個高中同學沒考上大學，他父母不但沒生氣，反而讓他去義大利遊學。他邊旅行邊學外文，後來就留在當地的職業學校念服裝設計，現在已經是服裝公司的大老闆了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我有一个高中同学没考上大学，他父母不但没生气，反而让他去义大利游学。他边旅行边学外文，后来就留在当地的职业学校念服装设计，现在已经是服装公司的大老板了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge gāozhōng tóngxué méi kǎoshàng dàxué, tā fùmǔ búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér ràng tā qù Yìdàlì yóuxué. Tā biān lǚxíng biān xué wàiwén, hòulái jiù liú zài dāngdì de zhíyè xuéxiào niàn fúzhuāng shèjì, xiànzài yǐjīng shì fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn le.
paragraphs.english: I had a high school classmate who didn't test into college; his parents didn't get angry at all, but sent him on a study trip to Italy instead. He studied foreign languages while traveling, later studied fashion design at a local vocational academy, and is now the boss of an apparel company.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 這樣的成就也很好啊！誰說一定要念大學才有美好的未來呢？
paragraphs.simplified: 这样的成就也很好啊！谁说一定要念大学才有美好的未来呢？
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhèyàng de chéngjiù yě hěn hǎo a! Shéi shuō yídìng yào niàn dàxué cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái ne?
paragraphs.english: That kind of accomplishment is wonderful too! Who can say that one must attend university to have a bright future?

items.title: 教育是有意義的學習
items.setting: 短文閱讀 · 教育是有意義的學習

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 臺灣社會一直都很重視學生的學習表現，尤其是考試的成績。人們似乎認為，成績好就代表書讀得好，書讀得好就會有美好的未來。因此，不少家長希望孩子能上好大學，甚至念到博士。為了達成這個目的，家長從孩子念國小、國中起，就非常注意每科的分數，老是擔心孩子進不了好高中、好大學。
paragraphs.simplified: 台湾社会一直都很重视学生的学习表现，尤其是考试的成绩。人们似乎认为，成绩好就代表书读得好，书读得好就会有美好的未来。因此，不少家长希望孩子能上好大学，甚至念到博士。为了达成这个目的，家长从孩子念国小、国中起，就非常注意每科的分数，老是担心孩子进不了好高中、好大学。
paragraphs.pinyin: Táiwān shèhuì yìzhí dōu hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de xuéxí biǎoxiàn, yóuqí shì kǎoshì de chéngjī. Rénmen sìhū rènwéi, chéngjī hǎo jiù dàibiǎo shū dú de hǎo, shū dú de hǎo jiù huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái. Yīncǐ, bù shǎo jiāzhǎng xīwàng háizi néng shàng hǎo dàxué, shènzhì niàn dào bóshì. Wèile dáchéng zhè ge mùdì, jiāzhǎng cóng háizi niàn guóxiǎo, guózhōng qǐ, jiù fēicháng zhùyì měi kē de fēnshù, lǎoshì dānxīn háizi jìn bù liǎo hǎo gāozhōng, hǎo dàxué.
paragraphs.english: Taiwanese society has always attached great importance to students' academic performance, especially test scores. People seem to believe that good grades equate to doing well in school, and doing well in school ensures a bright future. Consequently, many parents hope their children get into prestigious universities or even obtain doctorates. To achieve this goal, parents closely watch scores in every subject starting from elementary and junior high school, perpetually worrying their children won't enter top high schools or universities.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 有一些家長很誇張，不但陪孩子一起補習，還幫他們把筆記寫在本子上、把重點寫在便條上，以為孩子複習時用得著，這樣考試的成績就會更好。也有家長把孩子的學習時間排得很滿，下課後還叫他們寫很多考卷。後來，大家發現學生雖然掌握了考試的技巧，但在實際生活中碰到困難時，反而缺乏解決問題的能力。畢竟會考試，不代表擁有處理事情的能力。
paragraphs.simplified: 有一些家长很夸张，不但陪孩子一起补习，还帮他们把笔记写在本子上、把重点写在便条上，以为孩子复习时用得着，这样考试的成绩就会更好。也有家长把孩子的学习时间排得很满，下课后还叫他们写很多考卷。后来，大家发现学生虽然掌握了考试的技巧，但在实际生活中碰到困难时，反而缺乏解决问题的能力。毕竟会考试，不代表拥有处理事情的能力。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng hěn kuāzhāng, búdàn péi háizi yìqǐ bǔxí, hái bāng tāmen bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài biàntiáo shàng, yǐwéi háizi fùxí shí yòngdezháo, zhèyàng kǎoshì de chéngjī jiù huì gèng hǎo. Yě yǒu jiāzhǎng bǎ háizi de xuéxí shíjiān pái de hěn mǎn, xiàkè hòu hái jiào tāmen xiě hěn duō kǎojuàn. Hòulái, dàjiā fāxiàn xuéshēng suīrán zhǎngwò le kǎoshì de jǐqiào, dàn zài shíjì shēnghuó zhōng pèngdào kùnnán shí, fǎn'ér quēfá jiějué wèntí de nénglì. Bìjìng huì kǎoshì, bù dàibiǎo yǒngyǒu chǔlǐ shìqíng de nénglì.
paragraphs.english: Some parents go to extreme lengths: not only attending cram school with their children, but copying notes into notebooks and writing key points on sticky notes, thinking kids will find them useful when reviewing, thereby scoring higher on tests. Other parents pack schedules to the brim and assign piles of test papers after class. Later on, people found that while students mastered test-taking techniques, they lacked problem-solving capabilities when encountering real-world challenges. After all, testing well does not mean having practical competence.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 其實，因為每年出生的孩子越來越少，許多學校的新生也變少了，因為這樣，被大學錄取的機會反而大大地增加了。但是國中、高中的考試沒減少，家長對教育的想法也沒有太大的改變。孩子就算考上了好大學，沒實力的人恐怕畢業後也很難找到工作，更不可能擔任公司的主管，甚至最後變成整個社會的負擔。
paragraphs.simplified: 其实，因为每年出生的孩子越来越少，许多学校的新生也变少了，因为这样，被大学录取的机会反而大大地增加了。但是国中、高中的考试没减少，家长对教育的想法也没有太大的改变。孩子就算考上了好大学，没实力的人恐怕毕业后也很难找到工作，更不可能担任公司的主管，甚至最后变成整个社会的负担。
paragraphs.pinyin: Qíshí, yīnwèi měi nián chūshēng de háizi yuèláiyuè shǎo, xǔduō xuéxiào de xīnshēng yě biàn shǎo le, yīnwèi zhèyàng, bèi dàxué lùqǔ de jīhuì fǎn'ér dàdà de zēngjiā le. Dànshì guózhōng, gāozhōng de kǎoshì méi jiǎnshǎo, jiāzhǎng duì jiàoyù de xiǎngfǎ yě méiyǒu tài dà de gǎibiàn. Háizi jiùsuàn kǎoshàng le hǎo dàxué, méi shílì de rén kǒngpà bìyè hòu yě hěn nán zhǎodào gōngzuò, gèng bù kěnéng dānrèn gōngsī de zhǔguǎn, shènzhì zuìhòu biànchéng zhěnggè shèhuì de fùdān.
paragraphs.english: In fact, because fewer children are born each year, freshmen entering schools have declined, significantly increasing university admission rates instead. Yet junior and senior high exams have not decreased, and parents' educational mindset remains mostly unchanged. Even if a child tests into a good college, without genuine competence they will struggle to find employment, let alone serve as company managers, ultimately turning into burdens on society.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 這樣的例子一年比一年多。一直到最近幾年，家長和老師終於明白每個孩子都是獨特的，不是每個人都非念大學不可。再說，考試成績好的人，不一定就能幸福過日子。因此，有意義的學習是讓孩子以思考代替記答案，不僅給孩子自由的空間，發揮出自己的優點，而且還提供更好的教材和教學方式，讓孩子快樂地學習、成長。如果他們的能力可以變得更強，將來就能為社會貢獻一份力量了。
paragraphs.simplified: 这样的例子一年比一年多。一直到最近几年，家长和老师终于明白每个孩子都是独特的，不是每个人都非念大学不可。再说，考试成绩好的人，不一定就能幸福过日子。因此，有意义的学习是让孩子以思考代替记答案，不仅给孩子自由的空间，发挥出自己的优点，而且还提供更好的教材和教学方式，让孩子快乐地学习、成长。如果他们的能力可以变得更强，将来就能为社会贡献一份力量了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhèyàng de lìzi yì nián bǐ yì nián duō. Yìzhí dào zuìjìn jǐ nián, jiāzhǎng hé lǎoshī zhōngyú míngbái měi ge háizi dōu shì dútè de, búshì měi ge rén dōu fēi niàn dàxué bùkě. Zàishuō, kǎoshì chéngjī hǎo de rén, bù yídìng jiù néng xìngfú guò rìzi. Yīncǐ, yǒuyìyì de xuéxí shì ràng háizi yǐ sīkǎo dàitì jì dá'àn, bùjǐn gěi háizi zìyóu de kōngjiān, fāhuī chū zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, érqiě hái tígōng gèng hǎo de jiàocái hé jiàoxué fāngshì, ràng háizi kuàilè de xuéxí, chéngzhǎng. Rúguǒ tāmen de nénglì kěyǐ biàn de gèng qiáng, jiānglái jiù néng wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng le.
paragraphs.english: Such examples multiply year after year. Only in recent years have parents and educators finally realized that each child is unique and not everyone must attend university. Furthermore, individuals with high test scores do not necessarily lead happier lives. Meaningful education allows children to replace rote memorization with critical thinking, providing free space to develop talents, along with superior curricula and methods that foster joyful learning and growth. If their capabilities grow stronger, they can contribute meaningful strength to society in the future.

items.title: 健康檢查不麻煩

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 家豪，你手裡拿的是什麼？是健康檢查的簡介嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 家豪，你手里拿的是什么？是健康检查的简介吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Jiāháo, nǐ shǒuli ná de shì shénme? Shì jiànkāng jiǎnchá de jiǎnjiè ma?
paragraphs.english: Jiahao, what are you holding in your hand? Is it a brochure for health examinations?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 對啊，早上陪我阿姨去醫院辦理住院手續時，順便拿的，要帶回去給我爸媽看。
paragraphs.simplified: 对啊，早上陪我阿姨去医院办理住院手续时，顺便拿的，要带回去给我爸妈看。
paragraphs.pinyin: Duì a, zǎoshang péi wǒ āyí qù yīyuàn bànlǐ zhùyuàn shǒuxù shí, shùnbiàn ná de, yào dài huíqù gěi wǒ bàmā kàn.
paragraphs.english: Yes. I picked it up this morning while accompanying my aunt to handle her hospital admission, to take home for my parents to see.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 你阿姨怎麼了？昨天我還在超市遇到她，看起來很健康啊！
paragraphs.simplified: 你阿姨怎么了？昨天我还在此超市遇到她，看起来很健康啊！
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ āyí zěnme le? Zuótiān wǒ hái zài chāoshì yùdào tā, kàn qǐlái hěn jiànkāng a!
paragraphs.english: What happened to your aunt? I just ran into her at the supermarket yesterday and she looked in great health!

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 說也奇怪，她一向都有良好的飲食和生活習慣，也從來沒發覺自己有什麼毛病。直到上個月做了全身健康檢查，才知道病了。
paragraphs.simplified: 说也奇怪，她一向都有良好的饮食和生活习惯，也从来没发觉自己有什么毛病。直到上个月做了全身健康检查，才知道病了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shuō yě qíguài, tā yíxiàng dōu yǒu liánghǎo de yǐnshí hé shēnghuó xíguàn, yě cónglái méi fājué zìjǐ yǒu shénme máobìng. Zhídào shàng ge yuè zuò le quánshēn jiànkāng jiǎnchá, cái zhīdào bìng le.
paragraphs.english: Strange to say, she has always maintained healthy dietary and living habits, and never sensed anything wrong. Not until she underwent a comprehensive health check last month did she realize she was ill.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 每次聽你阿姨說話，都感覺她只想著照顧家人，自己一定沒想到會變成病人吧？
paragraphs.simplified: 每次听你阿姨说话，都感觉她只想著照顾家人，自己一定没想到会变成病人吧？
paragraphs.pinyin: Měicì tīng nǐ āyí shuōhuà, dōu gǎnjué tā zhǐ xiǎngzhe zhàogù jiārén, zìjǐ yídìng méi xiǎngdào huì biànchéng bìngrén ba?
paragraphs.english: Whenever I hear your aunt speak, I feel she only ever thinks of looking after her family; she certainly never imagined becoming a patient herself.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊，她是家庭主婦，生活很單純，每天管孩子、注意家人的健康，照顧家人就是她生活的重心，從沒想過自己也需要別人照顧。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊，她是家庭主妇，生活很单纯，每天管孩子、注意家人的健康，照顾家人就是她生活的重心，从没想过自己也需要别人照顾。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì a, tā shì jiātíng zhǔfù, shēnghuó hěn dānchún, měitiān guǎn háizi, zhùyì jiārén de jiànkāng, zhàogù jiārén jiù shì tā shēnghuó de zhòngxīn, cóng méi xiǎngguò zìjǐ yě xūyào biérén zhàogù.
paragraphs.english: Exactly. As a homemaker leading a quiet life, managing kids and watching over family health is the center of her life; she never considered that she too might need looking after.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 不過還好她去做了健檢，才知道該去看醫生。
paragraphs.simplified: 不过还好她去做了健检，才知道该去看医生。
paragraphs.pinyin: Búguò háihǎo tā qù zuò le jiànjiǎn, cái zhīdào gāi qù kàn yīshēng.
paragraphs.english: Still, it's fortunate she went for the checkup; only then did she know to see a doctor.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 妳說的沒錯。我早就想帶父母去做了，只不過他們覺得做健檢除了得花時間，還很麻煩，所以很被動，我得趁這個機會，跟他們溝通一下。
paragraphs.simplified: 你说的没错。我早就想带父母去做了，只不过他们觉得做健检除了得花时间，还很麻烦，所以很被动，我得趁这个机会，跟他们沟通一下。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò. Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng dài fùmǔ qù zuò le, zhǐbúguò tāmen juéde zuò jiànjiǎn chúle děi huā shíjiān, hái hěn máfan, suǒyǐ hěn bèidòng, wǒ děi chèn zhè ge jīhuì, gēn tāmen gōutōng yíxià.
paragraphs.english: You're right. I had long wanted to take my parents, except they feel exams take time and cause hassle, making them passive about it. I must seize this opportunity to talk with them.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 我先生也一樣。最近他頭痛了好幾天，我想帶他去看病，他不但不配合，反而很生氣地說：「我又沒什麼毛病，為什麼非去不可！」他死也不肯去，害我擔心得不得了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我先生也一样。最近他头痛了好几天，我想带他去看病，他不但不配合，反而很生气地说：“我又没什么毛病，为什么非去不可！”他死也不肯去，害我担心得不得了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ xiānsheng yě yíyàng. Zuìjìn tā tóutòng le hǎojǐ tiān, wǒ xiǎng dài tā qù kànbìng, tā búdàn bù pèihé, fǎn'ér hěn shēngqì de shuō: 'Wǒ yòu méi shénme máobìng, wèishénme fēi qù bùkě!' Tā sǐ yě bù kěn qù, hài wǒ dānxīn de bùdéliǎo.
paragraphs.english: My husband is just the same. He had headaches for several days recently, and when I wanted to take him to the clinic, far from cooperating, he snapped angrily: 'Nothing is wrong with me, why must I go!' He obstinately refused, causing me tremendous worry.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 如果感覺這麼不舒服，就是身體發出警告，表示健康有問題了。我看妳陪他去醫院，妳也順便做個免費的基本健檢吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 如果感觉这么不舒服，就是身体发出警告，表示健康有问题了。我看你陪他去医院，你也顺便做个免费的基本健检吧。
paragraphs.pinyin: Rúguǒ gǎnjué zhème bù shūfu, jiù shì shēntǐ fāchū jǐnggào, biǎoshì jiànkāng yǒu wèntí le. Wǒ kàn nǐ péi tā qù yīyuàn, nǐ yě shùnbiàn zuò ge miǎnfèi de jīběn jiànjiǎn ba.
paragraphs.english: If he feels that uncomfortable, that's the body sounding an alarm that health has issues. I suggest you accompany him to the hospital, and take advantage of a free basic checkup yourself.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 免費健檢的對象，好像年齡得滿四十歲。我還年輕呢！
paragraphs.simplified: 免费健检的对象，好像年龄得满四十岁。我还年轻呢！
paragraphs.pinyin: Miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn de duìxiàng, hǎoxiàng niánlíng děi mǎn sìshí suì. Wǒ hái niánqīng ne!
paragraphs.english: The eligibility for free checkups seems to require turning forty. I'm still young!

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 對不起，對不起。
paragraphs.simplified: 对不起，对不起。
paragraphs.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, duìbùqǐ.
paragraphs.english: My apologies, sorry about that.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 沒什麼啦！
paragraphs.simplified: 没什么啦！
paragraphs.pinyin: Méi shénme la!
paragraphs.english: No worries at all!

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 這家醫院的醫生挺有名的，應該很可靠，健檢手續也不麻煩，只要上網填個表就行了。
paragraphs.simplified: 这家医院的医生挺有名的，应该很可靠，健检手续也不麻烦，只要上网填个表就行了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de yīshēng tǐng yǒumíng de, yīnggāi hěn kěkào, jiànjiǎn shǒuxù yě bù máfan, zhǐyào shàngwǎng tián ge biǎo jiù xíng le.
paragraphs.english: The doctors at this hospital are quite renowned and should be dependable; checkup procedures aren't complicated either—just fill out an online form.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 我最大的願望就是家人都健健康康的。既然手續這麼簡單，那明天就先帶我先生去做個健檢吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 我最大的愿望就是家人都健健康康的。既然手续这么简单，那明天就先带我先生去做个健检吧。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ zuìdà de yuànwàng jiù shì jiārén dōu jiànjiànkāngkāng de. Jìrán shǒuxù zhème jiǎndān, nà míngtiān jiù xiān dài wǒ xiānsheng qù zuò ge jiànjiǎn ba.
paragraphs.english: My greatest wish is for my family to stay completely healthy. Since the procedure is that simple, tomorrow I'll take my husband for a health check.

items.title: 短文 · 追求健康與幸福的生活

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 家豪的伯伯林水木是一家玩具工廠的大老闆，工作三十年了。雖然這段期間遇到了不少挫折，但是他很堅強，為了給家人安定的生活、當員工的榜樣，他都努力克服、堅持到底，終於擁有了今天的成就。
paragraphs.simplified: 家豪的伯伯林水木是一家玩具工厂的大老板，工作三十年了。虽然这段期间遇到了不少挫折，但是他很坚强，为了给家人安定的生活、当员工的榜样，他都努力克服、坚持到底，终于拥有了今天的成就。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jiāháo de bóbo Lín Shuǐmù shì yì jiā wánjù gōngchǎng de dà lǎobǎn, gōngzuò sānshí nián le. Suīrán zhè duàn qījiān yùdào le bùshǎo cuòzhé, dànshì tā hěn jiānqiáng, wèile gěi jiārén āndìng de shēnghuó, dāng yuángōng de bǎngyàng, tā dōu nǔlì kèfú, jiānchí dàodǐ, zhōngyú yōngyǒu le jīntiān de chéngjiù.
paragraphs.english: Jiahao's uncle Lin Shuimu is the owner of a toy factory, where he has worked for thirty years. Although encountering numerous setbacks over this period, he remained steadfast; to provide stability for his family and serve as a model for employees, he persevered through difficulties to the very end, finally achieving today's success.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 過去三十年，林伯伯不但經常到各部門了解情況，對產品標準的要求也較高。他認為自己是公司的主角，要是少了他，銷售成績一定不理想。在家豪的記憶中，伯伯每天的生活就像打仗一樣，老是忙得忘了吃飯，有時緊張得睡不著。有一次他跟部門主管開會，因為討論得太激烈，頭突然痛得不得了，連站都站不起來，助理立刻送他到醫院去。
paragraphs.simplified: 过去三十年，林伯伯不但经常到各部门了解情况，对产品标准的要求也较高。他认为自己是公司的主角，要是少了他，销售成绩一定不理想。在家豪的记忆中，伯伯每天的生活就像打仗一样，老是忙得忘了吃饭，有时紧张得睡不着。有一次他跟部门主管开会，因为讨论得太激烈，头突然痛得不得了，连站都站不起来，助理立刻送他到医院去。
paragraphs.pinyin: Guòqù sānshí nián, Lín bóbo búdàn jīngcháng dào gè bùmén liǎojiě qíngkuàng, duì chǎnpǐn biāozhǔn de yāoqiú yě jiào gāo. Tā rènwéi zìjǐ shì gōngsī de zhǔjiǎo, yàoshì shǎo le tā, xiāoshòu chéngjī yídìng bù lǐxiǎng. Zài Jiāháo de jìyì zhōng, bóbo měitiān de shēnghuó jiù xiàng dǎzhàng yíyàng, lǎoshì máng de wàng le chīfàn, yǒushí jǐnzhāng de shuìbùzháo. Yǒu yí cì tā gēn bùmén zhǔguǎn kāihuì, yīnwèi tǎolùn de tài jīliè, tóu tūrán tòng de bùdéliǎo, lián zhàn dōu zhàn bù qǐlái, zhùlǐ lìkè sòng tā dào yīyuàn qù.
paragraphs.english: Over past decades, Uncle Lin not only inspected departments regularly, but maintained demanding product standards. He viewed himself as the company protagonist, believing sales would suffer without him. In Jiahao's memory, his uncle lived every day like a battle, constantly too busy to eat, and sometimes too stressed to sleep. Once in an intense executive meeting, a violent headache incapacitated him so badly he couldn't stand, prompting his assistant to rush him to the hospital.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 醫生告訴林伯伯，想要早日恢復健康，除了調整生活作息，還要培養符合健康的飲食習慣。比如每天早睡早起、按時間吃飯、運動三十分鐘，避免吃太鹹、太油的食物。他也一再警告林伯伯，別拿生命開玩笑，假如不改變過去的生活方式，恐怕連上帝也救不了了。
paragraphs.simplified: 医生告诉林伯伯，想要早日恢复健康，除了调整生活作息，还要培养符合健康的饮食习惯。比如每天早睡早起、按时间吃饭、运动三十分钟，避免吃太咸、太油的食物。他也一再警告林伯伯，别拿生命开玩笑，假如不改变过去的生活方式，恐怕连上帝也救不了了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosù Lín bóbo, xiǎng yào zǎorì huīfù jiànkāng, chúle tiáozhěng shēnghuó zuòxī, hái yào péiyǎng fúhé jiànkāng de yǐnshí xíguàn. Bǐrú měitiān zǎoshuì zǎoqǐ, àn shíjiān chīfàn, yùndòng sānshí fēnzhōng, bìmiǎn chī tài xián, tài yóu de shíwù. Tā yě yízài jǐnggào Lín bóbo, bié ná shēngmìng kāiwánxiào, jiǎrú bù gǎibiàn guòqù de shēnghuó fāngshì, kǒngpà lián Shàngdì yě jiù bù liǎo le.
paragraphs.english: The doctor advised Uncle Lin that regaining health required adjusting daily schedules and cultivating balanced diet habits: sleeping early and rising early, eating meals on time, exercising thirty minutes daily, and avoiding overly salty or greasy fare. He repeatedly warned Uncle Lin against gambling with life, saying that if past lifestyles persisted, even God couldn't save him.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 最初，林伯伯不太能適應這樣的改變，要是覺得食物的味道太淡，還是會加一些醬料；為了多運動，每天走路去上班，但經常走到一半就沒體力了，只好搭計程車。最後家人不得不一起來協助他，陪他吃飯、運動，甚至走路上下班。還好經過了一段時間，林伯伯終於恢復健康，不再教家人擔心了。
paragraphs.simplified: 最初，林伯伯不太能适应这样的改变，要是觉得食物的味道太淡，还是会加一些酱料；为了多运动，每天走路去上班，但经常走到一半就没体力了，只好搭出租车。最后家人不得不一起来协助他，陪他吃饭、运动，甚至走路上下班。还好经过了一段时间，林伯伯终于恢复健康，不再教家人担心了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zuìchū, Lín bóbo bú tài néng shìyìng zhèyàng de gǎibiàn, yàoshì juéde shíwù de wèidào tài dàn, háishì huì jiā yìxiē jiàngliào; wèile duō yùndòng, měitiān zǒulù qù shàngbān, dàn jīngcháng zǒu dào yíbàn jiù méi tǐlì le, zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē. Zuìhòu jiārén bùdébù yìqǐ lái xiézhù tā, péi tā chīfàn, yùndòng, shènzhì zǒulù shàngxiàbān. Háihǎo jīngguò le yí duàn shíjiān, Lín bóbo zhōngyú huīfù jiànkāng, búzài jiāo jiārén dānxīn le.
paragraphs.english: Initially, Uncle Lin struggled with the shift: when food tasted bland he still added sauces; to exercise he walked to work, but frequently ran out of steam halfway and hailed a taxi. Ultimately his family rallied to assist him, sharing meals, exercising, and even walking commutes together. Fortunately, after a while Uncle Lin recovered his health, bringing peace of mind back to his family.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 就在林伯伯為了健康而努力時，他的一位老朋友因為工作太累，僅僅五十歲就不幸去世了。這個壞消息給了林伯伯很大的刺激，讓他重新思考努力工作到底是為了什麼，真正的幸福又是什麼。或許，誰都找不到正確的答案，不過健康一定是最重要的。
paragraphs.simplified: 就在林伯伯为了健康而努力时，他的一位老朋友因为工作太累，仅仅五十岁就不幸去世了。这个坏消息给了林伯伯很大的刺激，让他重新思考努力工作到底是为什么，真正的幸福又是什么。或许，谁都找不到正确的答案，不过健康一定是最重要的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín bóbo wèile jiànkāng ér nǔlì shí, tā de yí wèi lǎo péngyǒu yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, jǐnjǐn wǔshí suì jiù búxìng qùshì le. Zhè ge huài xiāoxī gěi le Lín bóbo hěn dà de cìjī, ràng tā chóngxīn sīkǎo nǔlì gōngzuò dàodǐ shì wèile shénme, zhēnzhèng de xìngfú yòu shì shénme. Huòxǔ, shéi dōu zhǎobùdào zhèngquè de dá'àn, búguò jiànkāng yídìng shì zuì zhòngyào de.
paragraphs.english: Just as Uncle Lin was striving for health, an old colleague passed away at merely fifty years old from work exhaustion. This somber news dealt him a profound shock, causing him to reevaluate what relentless work is ultimately for, and what true happiness really means. Perhaps nobody has definitive answers, but good health is certainly paramount.

items.title: 網路交友要小心

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 最近新聞提到，有個博士透過社群網站，認識了一個女網友，給了她很多錢以後，才知道被騙了。
paragraphs.simplified: 最近新闻提到，有个博士透过社群网站，认识了一个女网友，给了她很多钱以后，才知道被骗了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zuìjìn xīnwén tídào, yǒu ge bóshì tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, rènshì le yí ge nǚ wǎngyǒu, gěi le tā hěn duō qián yǐhòu, cái zhīdào bèi piàn le.
paragraphs.english: The news recently reported that a PhD holder met a female netizen via social media, gave her a lot of money, and only then realized he had been swindled.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 我看過那個新聞。那個騙子假裝是大學生，故意找很老實的男生聊天，表面上對他們很好，等對方相信她以後就騙他們說，媽媽病了，需要錢看醫生。對吧？
paragraphs.simplified: 我看过那个新闻。那个骗子假装是大学生，故意找很老实的男生聊天，表面上对他们很好，等对方相信她以后就骗他们说，妈妈病了，需要钱看医生。对吧？
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ kànguò nà ge xīnwén. Nà ge piànzi jiǎzhuāng shì dàxuéshēng, gùyì zhǎo hěn lǎoshí de nánshēng liáotiān, biǎomiàn shàng duì tāmen hěn hǎo, děng duìfāng xiāngxìn tā yǐhòu jiù piàn tāmen shuō, māma bìng le, xūyào qián kàn yīshēng. Duì ba?
paragraphs.english: I saw that news. That scammer pretended to be a college student, deliberately chatted with honest men, acted very kindly on the surface, and once they trusted her, lied that her mother was sick and needed medical money. Right?

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 嗯。看到這類新聞，害我不敢上網交友了。你呢？你有這樣的經驗嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 嗯。看到这类新闻，害我不敢上网交友了。你呢？你有这样的经验吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Èn. Kàndào zhèlèi xīnwén, hài wǒ bù gǎn shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu le. Nǐ ne? Nǐ yǒu zhèyàng de jīngyàn ma?
paragraphs.english: Yes. Seeing news like this makes me afraid to make online friends. What about you? Have you had any experience like that?

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 以前遇過一次。剛開始我和對方只聊了幾句，後來有幾次聊電影聊得很開心，就越來越熟了，也會互相問候家人。
paragraphs.simplified: 以前遇过一次。刚开始我和对方只聊了几句，后来有几次聊电影聊得很开心，就越来越熟了，也会互相问候家人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yǐqián yùguò yí cì. Gāng kāishǐ wǒ hé duìfāng zhǐ liáo le jǐ jù, hòulái yǒu jǐ cì liáo diànyǐng liáo de hěn kāixīn, jiù yuèláiyuè shú le, yě huì hùxiāng wènhòu jiārén.
paragraphs.english: I encountered it once before. Initially we only chatted a few lines, but later after talking happily about movies several times, we grew closer and began asking after each other's families.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 那時候你想進一步認識對方嗎？比如說跟對方見個面、吃個飯什麼的。
paragraphs.simplified: 那时候你想进一步认识对方吗？比如说跟对方见个面、吃个饭什么的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nà shíhou nǐ xiǎng jìnyíbù rènshì duìfāng ma? Bǐrú shuō gēn duìfāng jiàn ge miàn, chī ge fàn shénme de.
paragraphs.english: At that time did you want to get to know her further? For example, meeting in person, sharing a meal, or something like that?

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 我沒想過跟她約會。不過大概過了一個月，她突然跟我說，家人發生嚴重的車禍，住院的費用很高，想跟我借十萬塊。
paragraphs.simplified: 我没想过跟她约会。不过大概过了一个月，她突然跟我说，家人发生严重的车祸，住院的费用很高，想跟我借十万块。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngguò gēn tā yuēhuì. Búguò dàgài guò le yí ge yuè, tā tūrán gēn wǒ shuō, jiārén fāshēng yánzhòng de chēhuò, zhùyuàn de fèiyòng hěn gāo, xiǎng gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài.
paragraphs.english: I never considered dating her. However, after about a month, she suddenly told me her family was in a severe car accident with high hospitalization costs, and wanted to borrow 100,000 NTD.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 十萬塊？這麼多！你借她了嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 十万块？这么多！你借她了吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Shí wàn kuài? Zhème duō! Nǐ jiè tā le ma?
paragraphs.english: 100,000 NTD? That's so much! Did you lend it to her?

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 當然沒。如果是兩萬塊以下，我可能願意借，十萬塊就太多了。再說，雖然對她不陌生，可是畢竟沒見過面，萬一借了以後才發現她說的都是假的，不但錢拿不回來，心也會很痛的。
paragraphs.simplified: 当然没。如果是两万块以下，我可能愿意借，十万块就太多了。再说，虽然对她不陌生，可是毕竟没见过面，万一借了以后才发现她说的都是假的，不但钱拿不回来，心也会很痛的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Dāngrán méi. Rúguǒ shì liǎng wàn kuài yǐxià, wǒ kěnéng yuànyì jiè, shí wàn kuài jiù tài duō le. Zàishuō, suīrán duì tā bù mòshēng, kěshì bìjìng méi jiànguò miàn, wànyī jiè le yǐhòu cái fāxiàn tā shuō de dōu shì jiǎ de, búdàn qián ná bù huílái, xīn yě huì hěn tòng de.
paragraphs.english: Of course not. If it were under 20,000 NTD, I might have been willing, but 100,000 is too much. Besides, though she wasn't an unfamiliar stranger, we hadn't met after all; if I lent it and discovered it was all fake, not only would the money be gone, it would hurt deeply.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊。有一些人在網路上填假資料，要是我們不小心，很可能就成了被騙的對象。不過，也許那個網友真的很可憐，需要你的幫助。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊。有一些人在网络上填假资料，要是我们不小心，很可能就成了被骗的对象。不过，也许那个网友真的很可怜，需要你的帮助。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì a. Yǒu yìxiē rén zài wǎnglù shàng tián jiǎ zīliào, yàoshì wǒmen bù xiǎoxīn, hěn kěnéng jiù chéng le bèi piàn de duìxiàng. Búguò, yěxǔ nà ge wǎngyǒu zhēnde hěn kělián, xūyào nǐ de bāngzhù.
paragraphs.english: Indeed. Some people fill out fake profiles online; if we aren't careful, we could easily become scam targets. Still, perhaps that netizen really was pitiful and needed your help.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 我本來也很同情她，還問她媽媽得住院住多久。可是她一下子說半個月，一下子說一個月，故意不說清楚。後來，我發現她不誠實，就不再跟她聯絡了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我本来也很同情她，还问她妈妈得住院住多久。可是她一下子说半个月，一下子说一个月，故意不说清楚。后来，我发现她不诚实，就不再跟她联络了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yě hěn tóngqíng tā, hái wèn tā māma děi zhùyuàn zhù duō jiǔ. Kěshì tā yíxiàzi shuō bàn ge yuè, yíxiàzi shuō yí ge yuè, gùyì bù shuō qīngchǔ. Hòulái, wǒ fāxiàn tā bù chéngshí, jiù búzài gēn tā liánluò le.
paragraphs.english: I was sympathetic at first, and asked how long her mother had to be hospitalized. But she said half a month one moment and a month the next, deliberately evading clarity. Later, finding her dishonest, I stopped contacting her.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 發現她不誠實？怎麼說呢？
paragraphs.simplified: 发现她不诚实？怎么说呢？
paragraphs.pinyin: Fāxiàn tā bù chéngshí? Zěnme shuō ne?
paragraphs.english: Found her dishonest? How so?

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 那時有一個網友把自己網路交友上當的經驗，寫在部落格上。我看了以後，發現騙他的人和跟我借錢的網友是同一個人，她用同樣的方法騙了不少人。
paragraphs.simplified: 那时有一个网友把自己网络交友上当的经验，写在部落格上。我看了以后，发现骗他的人和跟我借钱的网友是同一个人，她用同样的方法骗了不少人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nà shí yǒu yí ge wǎngyǒu bǎ zìjǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu shàngdàng de jīngyàn, xiě zài bùluògé shàng. Wǒ kàn le yǐhòu, fāxiàn piàn tā de rén hé gēn wǒ jiè qián de wǎngyǒu shì tóng yí ge rén, tā yòng tóngyàng de fāngfǎ piàn le bùshǎo rén.
paragraphs.english: At that time a netizen posted his experience being scammed through online dating on a blog. After reading it, I realized his scammer and the netizen borrowing money from me were the same person—she had defrauded many people the same way.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 這種人實在太可惡了。不過那時候你差點兒被騙了，後來還敢上網交朋友嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 这种人实在太可恶了。不过那时候你差点儿被骗了，后来还敢上网交朋友吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng rén shízài tài kěwù le. Búguò nà shíhou nǐ chàdiǎnr bèi piàn le, hòulái hái gǎn shàngwǎng jiāo péngyǒu ma?
paragraphs.english: That kind of person is truly despicable. But having nearly been scammed back then, did you dare make friends online afterward?

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 雖然我也看不起這種人，但網路交友的方式還是不錯的，而且網友也不都是壞人。
paragraphs.simplified: 虽然我也看不起这种人，但网络交友的方式还是不错的，而且网友也不都是坏人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yě kànbùqǐ zhè zhǒng rén, dàn wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì háishì búcuò de, érqiě wǎngyǒu yě bù dōu shì huàirén.
paragraphs.english: Although I also look down on such people, making friends online is still a good avenue, and netizens aren't all bad.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 聽你這麼說，讓我回想起剛來臺灣的時候，透過社群網站，找到了會說日語的臺灣網友。他幫我找房子、認識環境，真的很感謝他。
paragraphs.simplified: 听你这么说，让我回想起刚来台湾的时候，透过社群网站，找到了会说日语的台湾网友。他帮我找房子、认识环境，真的很感谢他。
paragraphs.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, ràng wǒ huíxiǎng qǐ gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, zhǎodào le huì shuō Rìyǔ de Táiwān wǎngyǒu. Tā bāng wǒ zhǎo fángzi, rènshì huánjìng, zhēnde hěn gǎnxiè tā.
paragraphs.english: Hearing you say that reminds me of when I first arrived in Taiwan: via social networks I found a Taiwanese netizen who spoke Japanese. He helped me find housing and familiarize myself with surroundings; I'm genuinely grateful to him.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 嗯！透過網路可以擴大交友的範圍，所以別因為有人被騙了，就拒絕使用這種交友方式。況且在真實生活中，騙子也不少啊！
paragraphs.simplified: 嗯！透过网络可以扩大交友的范围，所以别因为有人被骗了，就拒绝使用这种交友方式。况且在真实生活中，骗子也不少啊！
paragraphs.pinyin: Èn! Tòuguò wǎnglù kěyǐ kuòdà jiāoyǒu de fànwéi, suǒyǐ bié yīnwèi yǒu rén bèi piàn le, jiù jùjué shǐyòng zhè zhǒng jiāoyǒu fāngshì. Kuàngqiě zài zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng, piànzi yě bù shǎo a!
paragraphs.english: Yes! Through the internet we can expand our social circle, so don't reject this channel just because someone was scammed. Besides, there are plenty of swindlers in real life too!

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 你說的對。網路交友還是可靠的，也能認識不少興趣相同的朋友。像你建立的健身社團網站，裡面有很多訊息，包括健身的影片、舉行活動的日期和地點等等，都很有用、很吸引人。
paragraphs.simplified: 你说得对。网络交友还是可靠的，也能认识不少兴趣相同的朋友。像你建立的健身社团网站，里面有很多讯息，包括健身的影片、举行活动的日期和地点等等，都很有用、很吸引人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Wǎnglù jiāoyǒu háishì kěkào de, yě néng rènshì bùshǎo xìngqù xiāngtóng de péngyǒu. Xiàng nǐ jiànlì de jiànshēn shètuán wǎngzhàn, lǐmiàn yǒu hěn duō xùnxí, bāokuò jiànshēn de yǐngpiàn, jǔxíng huódòng de rìqí hé dìdiǎn děngděng, dōu hěn yǒuyòng, hěn xīyǐn rén.
paragraphs.english: You're right. Making friends online can still be reliable, helping us meet friends with shared interests. For instance, the fitness club site you built contains rich content—workout videos, event dates, locations—all very useful and engaging.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 既然妳覺得很吸引人，歡迎加入，免費喔！
paragraphs.simplified: 既然你觉得很吸引人，欢迎加入，免费喔！
paragraphs.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ juéde hěn xīyǐn rén, huānyíng jiārù, miǎnfèi o!
paragraphs.english: Since you find it appealing, welcome aboard—it's free!

items.title: 短文 · 網路交友的優缺點

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 自從無線網路出現的那天起，現代人的生活似乎就離不開網路了。網路科技的進步，不但改變了從前的生活方式，甚至連人與人之間的關係，也產生了極大的變化。住在不同地區的人，可以透過網路互相交流，這一點是我們祖父母那個年代的人很難想像的。
paragraphs.simplified: 自从无线网络出现的那天起，现代人的生活似乎就离不开网络了。网络科技的进步，不但改变了从前的生活方式，甚至连人与人之间的关系，也产生了极大的变化。住在不同地区的人，可以透过网络互相交流，这一点是我们祖父母那个年代的人很难想象的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zìcóng wúxiàn wǎnglù chūxiàn de nà tiān qǐ, xiàndài rén de shēnghuó sìhū jiù líbùkāi wǎnglù le. Wǎnglù kējì de jìnbù, búdàn gǎibiàn le cóngqián de shēnghuó fāngshì, shènzhì lián rén yǔ rén zhījiān de guānxì, yě chǎnshēng le jídà de biànhuà. Zhù zài bùtóng dìqū de rén, kěyǐ tòuguò wǎnglù hùxiāng jiāoliú, zhè yì diǎn shì wǒmen zǔfùmǔ nà ge niándài de rén hěn nán xiǎngxiàng de.
paragraphs.english: Ever since wireless internet emerged, modern life seems inseparable from the web. Technological advances not only altered former lifestyles, but profoundly transformed relationships between people. Individuals residing in diverse regions can connect online—something hard to fathom for our grandparents' generation.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 在網路出現以前，想要做報告，得去圖書館借一堆書；想要認識新朋友，就非和本人面對面接觸不可。但現代社會，只要有網路，就沒有時間和空間的限制，人人都可以隨時隨地傳訊息、查資料、認識世界各地的人。不但擴大了視野、增加了知識，甚至能和網友建立珍貴的友誼。但也因為這樣，越來越多人以網路傳訊息代替當面對話。時間久了，有些人反而失去了在真實生活中與人接觸的能力，這真是不可忽視的缺點。
paragraphs.simplified: 在网络出现以前，想要做报告，得去图书馆借一堆书；想要认识新朋友，就非和本人面对面接触不可。但现代社会，只要有网络，就没有时间和空间的限制，人人都可以随时随地传讯息、查资料、认识世界各地的人。不但扩大了视野、增加了知识，甚至能和网友建立珍贵的友谊。但也因为这样，越来越多人以网络传讯息代替当面对话。时间久了，有些人反而失去了在真实生活中与人接触的能力，这真是不可忽视的缺点。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù chūxiàn yǐqián, xiǎng yào zuò bàogào, děi qù túshūguǎn jiè yì duī shū; xiǎng yào rènshì xīn péngyǒu, jiù fēi hé běnrén miànduìmiàn jiēchù bùkě. Dàn xiàndài shèhuì, zhǐyào yǒu wǎnglù, jiù méiyǒu shíjiān hé kōngjiān de xiànzhì, rénrén dōu kěyǐ suíshí suídì chuán xùnxí, chá zīliào, rènshì shìjiè gèdì de rén. Búdàn kuòdà le shìyě, zēngjiā le zhīshì, shènzhì néng hé wǎngyǒu jiànlì zhēnguì de yǒuyì. Dàn yě yīnwèi zhèyàng, yuèláiyuè duō rén yǐ wǎnglù chuán xùnxí dàitì dāngmiàn duìhuà. Shíjiān jiǔ le, yǒuxiē rén fǎn'ér shīqù le zài zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng yǔ rén jiēchù de nénglì, zhè zhēn shì bù kě hūshì de quēdiǎn.
paragraphs.english: Before the internet, preparing reports meant borrowing piles of library books; meeting new people required face-to-face encounters. Today, with connectivity free from temporal and geographic boundaries, anyone can message, look up info, and meet people worldwide anytime, expanding horizons, building knowledge, and forging valuable friendships. Yet precisely because of this, more people substitute texting for in-person conversations. Over time, some lose real-world interpersonal competence—a significant drawback.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 再說，網路雖然為現代人帶來了不少好處，但也有壞處。比如有些人在網路上說的話不一定是真的。某人已經五十歲了，在網路上卻說自己才二十歲，甚至拿別人的照片當作自己的大頭照。更嚴重的是，有些騙子利用別人的同情心騙錢，那些騙子不僅可惡，還對不起社會。
paragraphs.simplified: 再说，网络虽然为现代人带来了不少好处，但也有坏处。比如有些人在网络上说的话不一定是真的。某人已经五十岁了，在网络上却说自己才二十岁，甚至拿别人的照片当作自己的大头照。更严重的是，有些骗子利用别人的同情心骗钱，那些骗子不仅可恶，还对不起社会。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zàishuō, wǎnglù suīrán wèi xiàndài rén dàilái le bùshǎo hǎochù, dàn yě yǒu huàichù. Bǐrú yǒuxiē rén zài wǎnglù shàng shuō de huà bù yídìng shì zhēn de. Mǒu rén yǐjīng wǔshí suì le, zài wǎnglù shàng què shuō zìjǐ cái èrshí suì, shènzhì ná biérén de zhàopiàn dāngzuò zìjǐ de dàtóuzhào. Gèng yánzhòng de shì, yǒuxiē piànzi lìyòng biérén de tóngqíngxīn piàn qián, nàxiē piànzi bùjǐn kěwù, hái duìbùqǐ shèhuì.
paragraphs.english: Furthermore, while the internet delivers immense convenience, it also brings harms. Online claims may not be truthful: someone already fifty may claim to be twenty, even stealing others' photos for their avatar. More gravely, fraudsters exploit empathy to extort money—scammers who are not only loathsome but fail society.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 網路只是提供一種更便利的交友方式給大家，至於要不要以網路交友，或是能不能找到合適的對象，就得看個人的智慧了。畢竟真實生活中的朋友，無論如何都比虛擬世界的網友重要，沒有人可以取代。
paragraphs.simplified: 网络只是提供一种更便利的交友方式给大家，至于要不要以网络交友，或是能不能找到合适的对象，就得看个人的智慧了。毕竟真实生活中的朋友，无论如何都比虚拟世界的网友重要，没有人可以取代。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhǐshì tígōng yì zhǒng gèng biànlì de jiāoyǒu fāngshì gěi dàjiā, zhìyú yào bú yào yǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, huòshì néng bù néng zhǎodào héshì de duìxiàng, jiù děi kàn gèrén de zhìhuì le. Bìjìng zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng de péngyǒu, wúlùn rúhé dōu bǐ xūnǐ shìjiè de wǎngyǒu zhòngyào, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
paragraphs.english: The internet merely offers a more convenient social conduit; as for whether to seek online friendships or successfully find suitable matches, that depends on personal discernment. After all, real-life companions remain incomparably more vital than virtual contacts and cannot be replaced.

items.title: 你有面試的經驗嗎？

paragraphs.speaker: 林家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 您好，我是林家豪。貴公司上星期通知我今天十點來面試。
paragraphs.simplified: 您好，我是林家豪。贵公司上星期通知我今天十点来面试。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nínhǎo, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Guì gōngsī shàngxīngqī tōngzhī wǒ jīntiān shí diǎn lái miànshì.
paragraphs.english: Hello, I am Lin Jiahao. Your company informed me last week to come for an interview at ten today.

paragraphs.speaker: 職員
paragraphs.traditional: 林先生，歡迎您來本公司參加面試。請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
paragraphs.simplified: 林先生，欢迎您来本公司参加面试。请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
paragraphs.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng, huānyíng nín lái běn gōngsī cānjiā miànshì. Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
paragraphs.english: Mr. Lin, welcome to our company for the interview. Please take a seat, I will inform the manager right away.

paragraphs.speaker: 王經理
paragraphs.traditional: 你好。我姓王，負責今天的面試。
paragraphs.simplified: 你好。我姓王，负责今天的面试。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐhǎo. Wǒ xìng Wáng, fùzé jīntiān de miànshì.
paragraphs.english: Hello. My surname is Wang, and I am in charge of today's interview.

paragraphs.speaker: 林家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 您好，王經理，我是林家豪。這是我的工作經驗相關資料，請您參考。
paragraphs.simplified: 您好，王经理，我是林家豪。这是我的工作经验相关资料，请您参考。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nínhǎo, Wáng jīnglǐ, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Zhè shì wǒ de gōngzuò jīngyàn xiāngguān zīliào, qǐng nín cānkǎo.
paragraphs.english: Hello, Manager Wang, I am Lin Jiahao. This is the information related to my work experience for your reference.

paragraphs.speaker: 王經理
paragraphs.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán, nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
paragraphs.english: We are looking for sales personnel this time. Do you have experience in this field?

paragraphs.speaker: 林家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 念大學時，我在電腦公司打過工。向客人介紹商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差異，最重要的是想辦法把商品賣出去。
paragraphs.simplified: 念大学时，我在电脑公司打过工。向客人介绍商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差异，最重要的是想办法把商品卖出去。
paragraphs.pinyin: Niàn dàxué shí, wǒ zài diànnǎo gōngsī dǎguo gōng. Xiàng kèrén jièshào shāngpǐn gōngnéng, shǐyòng fāngfǎ, hé qítā páizi de chāyì, zuì zhòngyào de shì xiǎng bànfǎ bǎ shāngpǐn mài chūqù.
paragraphs.english: In university, I worked part-time at a computer company, introducing product features, instructions, and differences from other brands to customers. The most important thing was finding ways to sell products.

paragraphs.speaker: 王經理
paragraphs.traditional: 不過推銷時，多多少少都會碰到喜歡隨便批評，甚至對你亂發脾氣的客人，你會怎麼處理呢？
paragraphs.simplified: 不过推销时，多多少少都会碰到喜欢随便批评，甚至对你乱发脾气的客人，你会怎么处理呢？
paragraphs.pinyin: Búguò tuīxiāo shí, duōduōshǎoshǎo dōu huì pèngdào xǐhuan suíbiàn pīpíng, shènzhì duì nǐ luàn fā píqì de kèrén, nǐ huì zěnme chǔlǐ ne?
paragraphs.english: However, when selling, you will more or less encounter customers who criticize casually or even lose their tempers at you. How would you handle that?

paragraphs.speaker: 林家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 我會先了解問題是什麼，然後耐心地跟他說明，想辦法讓他理解。我想只要態度親切、謙虛，客人就會接受的。萬一他還是不滿意，我就說笑話逗他開心，或是送他小禮物什麼的。
paragraphs.simplified: 我会先了解问题是什么，然后耐心地跟他说明，想办法让他理解。我想只要态度亲切、谦虚，客人就会接受的。万一他还是不满意，我就说笑话逗他开心，或是送他小礼物什么的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiān liǎojiě wèntí shì shénme, ránhòu nàixīn de gēn tā shuōmíng, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng tā lǐjiě. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào tàidù qīnqiè, qiānxū, kèrén jiù huì jiēshòu de. Wànyī tā háishì bù mǎnyì, wǒ jiù shuō xiàohuà dòu tā kāixīn, huòshì sòng tā xiǎo lǐwù shénme de.
paragraphs.english: I would first find out what the problem is, then patiently explain and help them understand. As long as one is warm and humble, customers will accept it. If they are still dissatisfied, I tease them with jokes to cheer them up, or give a small gift.

paragraphs.speaker: 王經理
paragraphs.traditional: 你的推銷觀念很正確。透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。在職場上，你碰過什麼大問題嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 你的推销观念很正确。透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。在职场上，你碰过什么大问题吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ de tuīxiāo guānniàn hěn zhèngquè. Tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfan. Zài zhíchǎng shàng, nǐ pèngguo shénme dà wèntí ma?
paragraphs.english: Your sales philosophy is sound. Through good communication, unnecessary troubles can often be resolved. In the workplace, have you encountered any major problems?

paragraphs.speaker: 林家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 沒有。不過有一次，公司舉辦電腦遊戲比賽，經理叫我們早上七點先去布置會場，因為鬧鐘壞了，我睡到八點才醒來。等我趕到時，小組的同事早就把任務完成了。雖然大家沒怪我，但我卻不能原諒自己，從那次之後，我就非常注意時間，絕對不再遲到了。
paragraphs.simplified: 没有。不过有一次，公司举办电脑游戏比赛，经理叫我们早上七点先去布置会场，因为闹钟坏了，我睡到八点才醒来。等我赶到时，小组的同事早就把任务完成了。虽然大家没怪我，但我却不能原谅自己，从那次之后，我就非常注意时间，绝对不再迟到了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Búguò yǒu yí cì, gōngsī jǔbàn diànnǎo yóuxì bǐsài, jīnglǐ jiào wǒmen zǎoshang qī diǎn xiān qù bùzhì huìchǎng, yīnwèi nàozhōng huài le, wǒ shuì dào bā diǎn cái xǐnglái. Děng wǒ gǎndào shí, xiǎozǔ de tóngshì zǎojiù bǎ rènwù wánchéng le. Suīrán dàjiā méi guài wǒ, dàn wǒ què bù néng yuánliàng zìjǐ, cóng nà cì zhīhòu, wǒ jiù fēicháng zhùyì shíjiān, juéduì bú zài chídào le.
paragraphs.english: No. But once, the company held a computer gaming contest, and the manager asked us to set up at seven in the morning. My alarm broke and I slept until eight. By the time I arrived, my teammates had already finished. Though no one blamed me, I couldn't forgive myself, and since then I've been extremely punctual and never late.

paragraphs.speaker: 王經理
paragraphs.traditional: 其實，不論在哪裡工作，準時是最基本的要求。對了，假如主管忙不過來，你願意配合加班嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 其实，不论在哪里工作，准时是最基本的要求。对了，假如主管忙不过来，你愿意配合加班吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Qíshí, búlùn zài nǎlǐ gōngzuò, zhǔnshí shì zuì jīběn de yāoqiú. Duì le, jiǎrú zhǔguǎn mángbuguòlái, nǐ yuànyì pèihé jiābān ma?
paragraphs.english: In fact, no matter where one works, punctuality is the most fundamental requirement. By the way, if the supervisor is too busy to manage, are you willing to cooperate with overtime?

paragraphs.speaker: 林家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 沒問題。平日或假日，我都能配合。
paragraphs.simplified: 没问题。平日或假日，我都能配合。
paragraphs.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Píngrì huò jiàrì, wǒ dōu néng pèihé.
paragraphs.english: No problem. Weekdays or holidays, I can accommodate.

paragraphs.speaker: 王經理
paragraphs.traditional: 除了準時，請你再說說自己其他的優點。
paragraphs.simplified: 除了准时，请你再说对自己其他的优点。
paragraphs.pinyin: Chúle zhǔnshí, qǐng nǐ zài shuōshuō zìjǐ qítā de yōudiǎn.
paragraphs.english: Besides punctuality, please tell me about your other strengths.

paragraphs.speaker: 林家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 我個性開朗、說話幽默、做事細心、溝通能力強，是個容易相處的人。
paragraphs.simplified: 我个性开朗、说话幽默、做事细心、沟通能力强，是个容易相处的人。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ gèxìng kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, zuòshì xìxīn, gōutōng nénglì qiáng, shì ge róngyì xiāngchǔ de rén.
paragraphs.english: I have an outgoing personality, a humorous way of speaking, pay attention to detail, communicate strongly, and am easy to get along with.

paragraphs.speaker: 王經理
paragraphs.traditional: 聽起來你挺優秀的。對這份工作你還有什麼要了解的？
paragraphs.simplified: 听起来你挺优秀的。对这份工作你还有什么要了解的？
paragraphs.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái nǐ tǐng yōuxiù de. Duì zhè fèn gōngzuò nǐ hái yǒu shénme yào liǎojiě de?
paragraphs.english: You sound quite outstanding. Is there anything else you would like to know about this job?

paragraphs.speaker: 林家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 請問薪水怎麼算？有哪些福利？
paragraphs.simplified: 请问薪水怎么算？有哪些福利？
paragraphs.pinyin: Qǐngwèn xīnshuǐ zěnme suàn? Yǒu nǎxiē fúlì?
paragraphs.english: May I ask how salary is calculated? What benefits are provided?

paragraphs.speaker: 王經理
paragraphs.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
paragraphs.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng.
paragraphs.english: Regarding questions in this area, relevant personnel will come explain them to you in detail.

items.title: 短文 · 我的面試經驗

paragraphs.traditional: 一般來說，現代人找工作得經過面試。面試時表現得好，被錄取的機會就比較大。今天，我就來跟各位說說我最近面試的經驗和感想。
paragraphs.simplified: 一般来说，现代人找工作得经过面试。面试时表现得好，被录取的机会就比较大。今天，我就来跟各位说说我最近面试的经验和感想。
