paragraphs.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, xiàndài rén zhǎo gōngzuò děi jīngguò miànshì. Miànshì shí biǎoxiàn de hǎo, bèi lùqǔ de jīhuì jiù bǐjiào dà. Jīntiān, wǒ jiù lái gēn gèwèi shuōshuo wǒ zuìjìn miànshì de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng.
paragraphs.english: Generally speaking, modern people must go through interviews to find jobs. Performing well in an interview brings greater chances of being hired. Today, let me share my recent interview experience and thoughts with everyone.
paragraphs.speaker: 旁白

paragraphs.traditional: 上個月，我在網站上，看到某家企業有銷售人員的需求，就立刻把個人資料寄過去。資料中除了說明我過去的工作經驗，也包含我對工作的看法和態度。兩個星期之後，我收到了面試通知。儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳，所以面試當天很早就醒來，出門前還一再確認穿著是不是整齊、資料是不是都放進了背包。我想，這樣又緊張又興奮的心情，往往是面試時經常有的表現。
paragraphs.simplified: 上个月，我在网站上，看到某家企业有销售人员的需求，就立刻把个人资料寄过去。资料中除了说明我过去的工作经验，也包含我对工作的看法和态度。两个星期之后，我收到了面试通知。尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳，所以面试当天很早就醒来，出门前还一再确认穿着是不是整齐、资料是不是都放进了背包。我想，这样又紧张又兴奋的心情，往往是面试时经常有的表现。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shàng gè yuè, wǒ zài wǎngzhàn shàng, kàndào mǒu jiā qǐyè yǒu xiāoshòu rényuán de xūqiú, jiù lìkè bǎ gèrén zīliào jì guòqù. Zīliào zhōng chúle shuōmíng wǒ guòqù de gōngzuò jīngyàn, yě bāohán wǒ duì gōngzuò de kànfǎ hé tàidù. Liǎng gè xīngqī zhīhòu, wǒ shōudào le miànshì tōngzhī. Jǐnguǎn wǒ bú shì dì-yī cì cānjiā miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā, suǒyǐ miànshì dāngtiān hěn zǎo jiù xǐnglái, chūmén qián hái yízài quèrèn chuānzhuó shì bú shì zhěngqí, zīliào shì bú shì dōu fàng jìn le bèibāo. Wǒ xiǎng, zhèyàng yòu jǐnzhāng yòu xīngfèn de xīnqíng, wǎngwǎng shì miànshì shí jīngcháng yǒu de biǎoxiàn.
paragraphs.english: Last month, I saw on a website that an enterprise needed sales personnel and sent my personal information immediately. Beyond outlining my past work experience, the materials covered my views and attitudes toward work. Two weeks later, I received an interview notification. Even though it wasn't my first interview, I still worried about performing poorly, so I woke up very early on the day, repeatedly verifying that my attire was neat and my materials were all packed. Such nervous yet excited feelings are often common during interviews.
paragraphs.speaker: 旁白

paragraphs.traditional: 一開始，經理請我說明對銷售工作的想法。我回答他，銷售人員是最常接觸顧客的，所以對客人要有禮貌，態度也要主動，絕對不能像木頭一樣沒反應；萬一他們亂發脾氣，就該忍耐、冷靜。畢竟，只顧自己的感覺，把跟顧客的關係搞壞，讓大家都不高興，又有什麼好處呢？
paragraphs.simplified: 一开始，经理请我说明对销售工作的想法。我回答他，销售人员是最常接触顾客的，所以对客人要有礼貌，态度也要主动，绝对不能像木头一样没反应；万一他们乱发脾气，就该忍耐、冷静。毕竟，只顾自己的感觉，把跟顾客的关系搞坏，让大家都不高兴，又有什么好处呢？
paragraphs.pinyin: Yì kāishǐ, jīnglǐ qǐng wǒ shuōmíng duì xiāoshòu gōngzuò de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ huídá tā, xiāoshòu rényuán shì zuì cháng jiēchù gùkè de, suǒyǐ duì kèrén yào yǒu lǐmào, tàidù yě yào zhǔdòng, juéduì bù néng xiàng mùtou yíyàng méi fǎnyìng; wànyī tāmen luàn fā píqì, jiù gāi rěnnài, lěngjìng. Bìjìng, zhǐ gù zìjǐ de gǎnjué, bǎ gēn gùkè de guānxì gǎo huài, ràng dàjiā dōu bù gāoxìng, yòu yǒu shénme hǎochù ne?
paragraphs.english: To begin, the manager asked for my thoughts on sales work. I replied that sales staff have the closest contact with customers, so one must be polite, take the initiative, and never act unresponsive like a piece of wood. If customers lose their temper, one should be patient and calm. After all, considering only one's own feelings and ruining relations with customers brings no benefit.
paragraphs.speaker: 旁白

paragraphs.traditional: 後來，經理又問我對團體合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小組的方式來推銷產品，所以能理解合作是必要的。況且，主管要領導整個部門，為全公司創造好成績，要是小組人員不配合，恐怕就不能順利實行銷售計畫，也會出現混亂的情況。因此，為了公司，我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
paragraphs.simplified: 后来，经理又问我对团体合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小组的方式来推销产品，所以能理解合作是必要的。况且，主管要领导整个部门，为全公司创造好成绩，要是小组人员不配合，恐怕就不能顺利实行销售计划，也会出现混乱的情况。因此，为了公司，我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
paragraphs.pinyin: Hòulái, jīnglǐ yòu wèn wǒ duì tuántǐ hézuò de kànfǎ. Wǒ zhīqián de gōngzuò, jiù shì yǐ xiǎozǔ de fāngshì lái tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn, suǒyǐ néng lǐjiě hézuò shì bìyào de. Kuàngqiě, zhǔguǎn yào lǐngdǎo zhěnggè bùmén, wèi quán gōngsī chuàngzào hǎo chéngjì, yàoshi xiǎozǔ rényuán bù pèihé, kǒngpà jiù bù néng shùnlì shíxíng xiāoshòu jìhuà, yě huì chūxiàn hùnluàn de qíngkuàng. Yīncǐ, wèile gōngsī, wǒ rènwéi búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, zhǐyào shì hélǐ de, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
paragraphs.english: Later, the manager asked about my views on teamwork. My previous work promoted products in teams, so I understand cooperation is essential. Moreover, supervisors lead entire departments to create results; without staff cooperation, plans cannot proceed smoothly and chaos results. Therefore, no matter what reasonable requests the supervisor makes, employees should cooperate.
paragraphs.speaker: 旁白

paragraphs.traditional: 最後，經理問我要是被錄取了，能為公司付出什麼。我說，在推銷產品方面，我的經驗很豐富，商品銷售可說是我一輩子的事業，所以一定會盡最大的力量認真工作、完成任務。
paragraphs.simplified: 最后，经理问我要是被录取了，能为公司付出什么。我说，在推销产品方面，我的经验很丰富，商品销售可说是我一辈子的事业，所以一定会尽最大的力量认真工作、完成任务。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zuìhòu, jīnglǐ wèn wǒ yàoshi bèi lùqǔ le, néng wèi gōngsī fùchū shénme. Wǒ shuō, zài tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn fāngmiàn, wǒ de jīngyàn hěn fēngfù, shāngpǐn xiāoshòu kě shuō shì wǒ yíbèizi de shìyè, suǒyǐ yídìng huì jìn zuìdà de lìliàng rènzhēn gōngzuò, wánchéng rènwù.
paragraphs.english: Finally, the manager asked what I could contribute to the company if hired. I stated that my experience in sales is extensive, that sales can be said to be my lifelong career, and that I would dedicate my utmost efforts to working conscientiously and accomplishing missions.
paragraphs.speaker: 旁白

paragraphs.traditional: 上星期我收到了通過面試的通知，下個月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我終於美夢成真了。很多人說，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一點兒運氣。其實，個性、能力，加上不斷地努力才是最重要的。
paragraphs.simplified: 上星期我收到了通过面试的通知，下个月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我终于美梦成真了。很多人说，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一点儿运气。其实，个性、能力，加上不断地努力才是最重要的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī wǒ shōudào le tōngguò miànshì de tōngzhī, xià gè yuè jiù yào shàngbān le. Pànwàng le hǎojiǔ, wǒ zhōngyú měimèng chéngzhēn le. Hěn duō rén shuō, xiǎng zhǎodào lǐxiǎng de gōngzuò, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào yìdiǎnr yùnqì. Qíshí, gèxìng, nénglì, jiāshàng búduàn de nǔlì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
paragraphs.english: Last week I received notification of passing the interview, and I start next month. After longing for so long, my dream has finally come true. Many say finding an ideal job takes a bit of luck, but personality, ability, and persistent effort are truly what matter most.
paragraphs.speaker: 旁白

paragraphs.traditional: 以上就是我找工作的經驗和感想，如果有任何問題，歡迎跟我聯絡，謝謝！
paragraphs.simplified: 以上就是我找工作的经验和感想，如果有任何问题，欢迎跟我联络，谢谢！
paragraphs.pinyin: Yǐshàng jiù shì wǒ zhǎo gōngzuò de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng, rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng gēn wǒ liánluò, xièxie!
paragraphs.english: The above is my experience and reflection on job seeking. If you have questions, please feel free to contact me. Thank you!
paragraphs.speaker: 旁白

items.title: 雲端科技真方便

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 明哲，你不要一直看手機啦。
paragraphs.simplified: 明哲，你不要一直看手机啦。
paragraphs.pinyin: Míngzhé, nǐ bú yào yìzhí kàn shǒujī la.
paragraphs.english: Mingzhe, don't keep staring at your phone all the time.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 我在查借書記錄，看看雲端圖書館的電子書還能借多久。
paragraphs.simplified: 我在查借书记录，看看云端图书馆的电子书还能借多久。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ zài chá jiè shū jìlù, kànkan yúnduān túshūguǎn de diànzǐshū hái néng jiè duō jiǔ.
paragraphs.english: I'm checking my borrowing record to see how much longer I can keep the cloud library e-book.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 我從來沒用過雲端圖書館系統，你可以教我嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 我从来没用过云端图书馆系统，你可以教我吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi yòngguo yúnduān túshūguǎn xìtǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
paragraphs.english: I have never used the cloud library system before. Could you teach me?

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 妳只要上雲端圖書館的網站填資料，建立帳號、密碼，就能用了。
paragraphs.simplified: 你只要上云端图书馆的网站填资料，建立账号、密码，就能用了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐyào shàng yúnduān túshūguǎn de wǎngzhàn tián zīliào, jiànlì zhànghào, mìmǎ, jiù néng yòng le.
paragraphs.english: You just need to fill in information on the cloud library website and create an account and password, then you can use it.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 聽起來不難嘛！什麼時候借都可以嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 听起来不难嘛！什么时候借都可以吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái bù nán ma! Shénme shíhou jiè dōu kěyǐ ma?
paragraphs.english: Sounds easy! Can you borrow anytime?

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊，而且還書時間一到，系統就會自動還書。不像以前，想借書只能親自跑一趟圖書館，要是多借了幾本，還得抱著一堆書回家。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊，而且还书时间一到，系统就会自动还书。不像以前，想借书只能亲自跑一趟图书馆，要是多借了几本，还得抱着一堆书回家。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě huán shū shíjiān yí dào, xìtǒng jiù huì zìdòng huán shū. Bù xiàng yǐqián, xiǎng jiè shū zhǐ néng qīnzì pǎo yí tàng túshūguǎn, yàoshi duō jiè le jǐ běn, hái děi bàozhe yì duī shū huí jiā.
paragraphs.english: Yes, and as soon as the due date arrives, the system returns it automatically. Unlike before, when borrowing required a trip to the library, and borrowing several books meant lugging a stack home.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 現在的讀者實在太幸福了。
paragraphs.simplified: 现在的读者实在太幸福了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xiàndài de dúzhě shízài tài xìngfú le.
paragraphs.english: Modern readers are truly fortunate.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 就是啊，只要帶著手機或平板，就能隨時隨地閱讀了。
paragraphs.simplified: 就是啊，只要带着手机或平板，就能随时随地阅读了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jiù shì a, zhǐyào dàizhe shǒujī huò píngbǎn, jiù néng suíshí suídì yuèdú le.
paragraphs.english: Exactly; as long as you carry a phone or tablet, you can read anytime, anywhere.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 這樣我的書包就能變得很空，放得下外套、雨傘什麼的。
paragraphs.simplified: 这样我的书包就能变得很空，放得下外套、雨伞什么的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhèyàng wǒ de shūbāo jiù néng biàn de hěn kōng, fàng de xià wàitào, yǔsǎn shénme de.
paragraphs.english: That way my schoolbag can become very spacious, leaving room for a coat, umbrella, and so on.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊。現在我什麼文件都存在雲端，要是忘了帶隨身碟也不必擔心。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊。现在我什么文件都存在云端，要是忘了带随身碟也不必担心。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ shénme wénjiàn dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàoshi wàng le dài suíshēndié yě bú bì dānxīn.
paragraphs.english: Indeed. Now I store all documents in the cloud; even if I forget my flash drive, there is no need to worry.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 有一次小組發表報告前五分鐘，我發現忘了帶隨身碟，也沒把預備好的資料寄到同學的電子信箱。我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份，問題就馬上解決了。
paragraphs.simplified: 有一次小组发表报告前五分钟，我发现忘了带随身碟，也没把预备好的资料寄到同学的电子信箱。我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份，问题就马上解决了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì xiǎozǔ fābiǎo bàogào qián wǔ fēnzhōng, wǒ fāxiàn wàng le dài suíshēndié, yě méi bǎ yùbèi hǎo de zīliào jì dào tóngxué de diànzǐ xìnxīang. Wǒ nà shíhou xiǎng, zhèxiàzi méi bànfǎ bàogào le, hái hǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn, wèntí jiù mǎshàng jiějué le.
paragraphs.english: Once, five minutes before our group presentation, I found I had forgotten my flash drive and hadn't emailed the prepared files to classmates. I thought, 'Now we can't present!' Luckily a classmate said there was a copy on the cloud, and the problem was resolved immediately.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 現在的網路科技水平提高了不少，企業能透過高速網路把資料上傳到雲端處理，不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
paragraphs.simplified: 现在的网络科技水平提高了不少，企业能透过高速网络把资料上传到云端处理，不同地区的人也能在网络上一起开会，既省时间又方便，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xiànzài de wǎnglù kējì shuǐpíng tígāo le bù shǎo, qǐyè néng tòuguò gāosù wǎnglù bǎ zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān chǔlǐ, bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn, gèng bié shuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào, chuán xùnxí děng jīběn fúwù le.
paragraphs.english: Internet technology standards have improved considerably. Enterprises can upload data to the cloud via high-speed internet for processing, and people in different regions can meet online—saving time and being convenient, not to mention basic personal services like downloads and messaging.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 除了這些優點，雲端還能把會議資料自動存起來，也能把變更的時間和內容記錄下來，讓不能參加會議的人隨時掌握最新情況。
paragraphs.simplified: 除了这些优点，云端还能把会议资料自动存起来，也能把变更的时间和内容记录下来，让不能参加会议的人随时掌握最新情况。
paragraphs.pinyin: Chúle zhèxiē yōudiǎn, yúnduān hái néng bǎ huìyì zīliào zìdòng cún qǐlái, yě néng bǎ biàngēng de shíjiān hé nèiróng jìlù xiàlái, ràng bù néng cānjiā huìyì de rén suíshí zhǎowò zuìxīn qíngkuàng.
paragraphs.english: Besides these merits, the cloud automatically archives meeting materials and logs change times and details, enabling absent members to keep abreast of updates anytime.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 其實也有不少老師利用這樣的科技，把教材放上雲端，讓學生預習、複習，提高學習的效果。
paragraphs.simplified: 其实也有不少老师利用这样的科技，把教材放上云端，让学生预习、复习，提高学习的效果。
paragraphs.pinyin: Qíshí yě yǒu bù shǎo lǎoshī lìyòng zhèyàng de kējì, bǎ jiàocái fàng shàng yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí, fùxí, tígāo xuéxí de xiàoguǒ.
paragraphs.english: Actually, quite a few teachers use this technology, putting course materials on the cloud for students to preview and review, boosting learning efficacy.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 不過，我覺得要利用雲端科技來改變傳統的教學方式，恐怕說起來容易，做起來不簡單吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 不过，我觉得要利用云端科技来改变传统的教学方式，恐怕说起来容易，做起来不简单吧。
paragraphs.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ juéde yào lìyòng yúnduān kējì lái gǎibiàn chuántǒng de jiàoxué fāngshì, kǒngpà shuōqǐlái róngyì, zuòqǐlái bù jiǎndān ba.
paragraphs.english: However, using cloud technology to transform conventional teaching methods is probably easier said than done.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 明天系主任邀請馬博士來演講，題目跟雲端科技有關，妳要一起去嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 明天系主任邀请马博士来演讲，题目跟云端科技有关，你要一起去吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Míngtiān xì zhǔrèn yāoqǐng Mǎ bóshì lái yǎnjiǎng, tímù gēn yúnduān kējì yǒuguān, nǐ yào yìqǐ qù ma?
paragraphs.english: Tomorrow the department chair invited Dr. Ma to give a lecture on cloud tech. Do you want to go together?

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 說實話，我本來對雲端科技沒什麼興趣，今天聽你說了這麼多，似乎該研究一下了。
paragraphs.simplified: 说实话，我本来对云端科技没什么兴趣，今天听你说了这么多，似乎该研究一下了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wǒ běnlái duì yúnduān kējì méi shénme xìngqù, jīntiān tīng nǐ shuō le zhème duō, sìhū gāi yánjiū yíxià le.
paragraphs.english: Honestly, I initially had little interest in cloud tech, but hearing you share so much today, it seems I should look into it.

paragraphs.speaker: 明哲
paragraphs.traditional: 那我明天騎摩托車去接妳。
paragraphs.simplified: 那我明天骑摩托车去接你。
paragraphs.pinyin: Nà wǒ míngtiān qí mótuōchē qù jiē nǐ.
paragraphs.english: Then I'll pick you up on my scooter tomorrow.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 太好了！麻煩你了！
paragraphs.simplified: 太好了！麻烦你了！
paragraphs.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Máfan nǐ le!
paragraphs.english: Wonderful! Thanks so much!

items.title: 短文 · 走向雲端的新時代

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 想當年還沒有雲端科技時，人們不論想閱讀某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某類題材的文章，都得到圖書館去查資料、借書。不過，自從有了雲端之後，人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
paragraphs.simplified: 想当年还没有云端科技时，人们不论想阅读某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某类题材的文章，都得到图书馆去查资料、借书。不过，自从有了云端之后，人们就是不出门，也可透过网络满足相关的需求。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xiǎng dāngnián hái méiyǒu yúnduān kējì shí, rénmen búlùn xiǎng yuèdú mǒu wèi zuòzhě chūbǎn de zuòpǐn, huòshì xūyào zhǎo mǒu lèi tícái de wénzhāng, dōu děi dào túshūguǎn qù chá zīliào, jiè shū. Búguò, zìcóng yǒu le yúnduān zhīhòu, rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú.
paragraphs.english: Back in the days before cloud technology, whether people wanted to read works published by an author or find articles on a topic, they had to go to libraries to research and borrow books. Since the advent of the cloud, however, people can satisfy relevant needs online without leaving home.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 雲端科技的主要功能，是讓人們能隨時隨地上傳或下載資料；也因為不需要使用紙、筆來記錄，還能為地球的環保盡一份力量。以往，雲端科技多用來管理資料和電子郵件；現在遇到淹水、颱風的特殊情況，不出門也能在家開會或學習，把該做的事情都做好。上班族在家中裝上了攝影機，透過手機或電腦能看到家人的活動情況，要是他們碰上了麻煩，就能立刻請鄰居或警察協助。除了個人，企業在管理公共空間或服務方面也用得著雲端。比如說，旅館透過雲端掌握房客進出的情況、調整房間內冷氣的強弱等等。以上都是雲端科技帶來的好處。
paragraphs.simplified: 云端科技的主要功能，是让人们能随时随地上传或下载资料；也因为不需要使用纸、笔来记录，还能为地球的环保尽一份力量。以往，云端科技多用来管理资料和电子邮件；现在遇到淹水、台风的特殊情况，不出门也能在家开会或学习，把该做的事情都做好。上班族在家中装上了摄影机，透过手机或电脑能看到家人的活动情况，要是他们碰上了麻烦，就能立刻请邻居或警察协助。除了个人，企业在管理公共空间或服务方面也用得着云端。比如说，旅馆透过云端掌握房客进出的情况、调整房间内冷气的强弱等等。以上都是云端科技带来的好处。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yúnduān kējì de zhǔyào gōngnéng, shì ràng rénmen néng suíshí suídì shàngchuán huò xiàzài zīliào; yě yīnwèi bù xūyào shǐyòng zhǐ, bǐ lái jìlù, hái néng wèi dìqiú de huánbǎo jìn yí fèn lìliàng. Yǐwǎng, yúnduān kējì duō yòng lái guǎnlǐ zīliào hé diànzǐ yóujiàn; xiànzài yùdào yānshuǐ, táifēng de tèshū qíngkuàng, bù chūmén yě néng zài jiā kāihuì huò xuéxí, bǎ gāi zuò de shìqing dōu zuò hǎo. Shàngbānzú zài jiā zhōng zhuāng shàng le shèyǐngjī, tòuguò shǒujī huò diànnǎo néng kàndào jiārén de huódòng qíngkuàng, yàoshi tāmen pèng shàng le máfan, jiù néng lìkè qǐng línjū huò jǐngchá xiézhù. Chúle gèrén, qǐyè zài guǎnlǐ gōnggòng kōngjiān huò fúwù fāngmiàn yě yòng de zháo yúnduān. Bǐrú shuō, lǚguǎn tòuguò yúnduān zhǎowò fángkè jìnchū de qíngkuàng, tiáozhěng fángjiān nèi lěngqì de qiángruò děngděng. Yǐshàng dōu shì yúnduān kējì dàilái de hǎochù.
paragraphs.english: The primary function of cloud tech is enabling people to upload and download data anywhere, anytime; avoiding paper and pen also contributes to environmental conservation. Previously used mainly for data and email management, during flooding or typhoons it allows remote meetings and studies. Commuters can view household activity via cameras on phone or PC and seek prompt assistance if issues arise. Beyond individuals, businesses utilize the cloud for public space and service management—hotels track guest movements and adjust AC levels. All these are benefits brought by cloud technology.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 但話說回來，雖然雲端的優點不少，卻還是有現實的問題需要克服。例如某個時刻突然停電了，或是連不上網路，再重要的會議也只能暫時停下來；也可能因為雲端系統出現安全問題，上傳的資料突然沒了或被偷了。所以最好別太依靠雲端，重要資料也應多存一份。
paragraphs.simplified: 但话说回来，虽然云端的优点不少，却还是有现实的问题需要克服。例如某个时刻突然停电了，或是连不上网络，再重要的会议也只能暂时停下来；也可能因为云端系统出现安全问题，上传的资料突然没了或被偷了。所以最好别太依靠云端，重要资料也应多存一份。
paragraphs.pinyin: Dàn huàshuōhuílái, suīrán yúnduān de yōudiǎn bù shǎo, què háishì yǒu xiànshí de wèntí xūyào kèfú. Lìrú mǒu ge shíkè tūrán tíngdiàn le, huòshì lián bú shàng wǎnglù, zài zhòngyào de huìyì yě zhǐ néng zhànshí tíng xiàlái; yě kěnéng yīnwèi yúnduān xìtǒng chūxiàn ānquán wèntí, shàngchuán de zīliào tūrán méi le huò bèi tōu le. Suǒyǐ zuìhǎo bié tài yīkào yúnduān, zhòngyào zīliào yě yīng duō cún yí fèn.
paragraphs.english: Then again, though the cloud offers many perks, practical challenges persist. A sudden power outage or connectivity failure halts even crucial meetings; security breaches can cause uploaded files to vanish or be compromised. Hence one should not rely solely on the cloud and keep duplicate backups of essential data.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 雲端就像一張大網，把各種資源連在一起，提供各式各樣的服務，一方面帶給人們更便利的生活，一方面也帶給企業更良好的管理方式，對全球商業、教育、文化等方面都產生了重大的影響，相信未來雲端能夠帶領我們走向美好的新時代。
paragraphs.simplified: 云端就像一张大网，把各种资源连在一起，提供各式各样的服务，一方面带给人们更便利的生活，一方面也带给企业更良好的管理方式，对全球商业、教育、文化等方面都产生了重大的影响，相信未来云端能够带领我们走向美好的新时代。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yúnduān jiù xiàng yì zhāng dà wǎng, bǎ gèzhǒng zīyuán lián zài yìqǐ, tígōng gèshì gèyàng de fúwù, yì fāngmiàn dài gěi rénmen gèng biànlì de shēnghuó, yì fāngmiàn yě dài gěi qǐyè gèng liánghǎo de guǎnlǐ fāngshì, duì quánqiú shāngyè, jiàoyù, wénhuà děng fāngmiàn dōu chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng, xiāngxìn wèilái yúnduān nénggòu dàilǐng wǒmen zǒuxiàng měihǎo de xīn shídài.
paragraphs.english: The cloud is like an immense web linking diverse resources to deliver myriad services. It brings convenience to people while equipping enterprises with refined management, exerting profound impact across global business, education, and culture, and guiding us toward a prosperous new era.

items.title: 七夕情人節的故事
items.titleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 你這個布做的錢包好漂亮，在哪裡買的？
paragraphs.simplified: 你这个布做的钱包好漂亮，在哪里买的？
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ zhège bù zuò de qiánbāo hǎo piàoliang, zài nǎlǐ mǎi de?
paragraphs.english: This cloth wallet of yours is so pretty. Where did you buy it?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 是我女朋友親手做的七夕情人節禮物。法國也有情人節吧？
paragraphs.simplified: 是我女朋友亲手做的七夕情人节礼物。法国也有情人节吧？
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì wǒ nǚpéngyǒu qīnshǒu zuò de Qīxī Qíngrénjié lǐwù. Fǎguó yě yǒu Qíngrénjié ba?
paragraphs.english: It's a Qixi Valentine's gift handmade by my girlfriend. France has Valentine's Day too, right?

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 有啊，不過不是在七夕。你們這個節日背後應該有故事吧？
paragraphs.simplified: 有啊，不过不是在七夕。你们这个节日背后应该有故事吧？
paragraphs.pinyin: Yǒu a, bùguò búshì zài Qīxī. Nǐmen zhège jiérì bèihòu yīnggāi yǒu gùshì ba?
paragraphs.english: Yes, but not on Qixi. There must be a story behind your festival, right?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 這就要從牛郎、織女說起了。從前有個叫牛郎的青年，每天都帶著老牛去田裡工作。有一天，他在河邊休息時，看見了一位非常美麗的姑娘。
paragraphs.simplified: 这就要从牛郎、织女说起了。从前有个叫牛郎的青年，每天都带着老牛去田里工作。有一天，他在河边休息时，看见了一位非常美丽的姑娘。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhè jiù yào cóng Niúláng, Zhīnǚ shuōqǐ le. Cóngqián yǒu ge jiào Niúláng de qīngnián, měitiān dōu dài zhe lǎoniú qù tián lǐ gōngzuò. Yǒu yì tiān, tā zài hébiān xiūxí shí, kànjiàn le yí wèi fēicháng měilì de gūniáng.
paragraphs.english: That has to be told starting from the Cowherd and Weaver Girl. Once there was a young man named Niulang who took his old ox to work the fields every day. One day while resting by the river, he saw an exceptionally beautiful girl.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 我猜牛郎第一眼看到她，就覺得遇到了真愛吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 我猜牛郎第一眼看到她，就觉得遇到了真爱吧。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ cāi Niúláng dì-yī yǎn kàndào tā, jiù juéde yùdào le zhēn'ài ba.
paragraphs.english: I bet the very first moment Niulang saw her, he felt he had found true love.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊。那個天真可愛的姑娘名叫織女，她是天上的仙女，跟著幾個姊姊來人間玩，過幾天就得回到天上。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊。那个天真可爱的小姑娘名叫织女，她是天上的仙女，跟着几个姐姐来人间玩，过几天就得回到天上。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shì a. Nàge tiānzhēn kě'ài de gūniáng míng jiào Zhīnǚ, tā shì tiānshàng de xiānnǚ, gēn zhe jǐ ge jiějiě lái rénjiān wán, guò jǐ tiān jiù děi huídào tiānshàng.
paragraphs.english: Indeed. That innocent and lovely girl was named Weaver Girl. She was a celestial fairy from heaven, visiting the mortal world with her older sisters for fun, and had to return to heaven after a few days.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 牛郎不想把她留下來嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 牛郎不想把她留下来吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Niúláng bù xiǎng bǎ tā liú xiàlái ma?
paragraphs.english: Didn't Niulang want to keep her here?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 當然想啊！為了把織女留在身邊，牛郎就拿走了能讓織女飛回天上的衣服。後來，因為牛郎很溫柔、很體貼，織女就慢慢愛上他了，最後他們成了夫婦，還生了兩個寶貝。
paragraphs.simplified: 当然想啊！为了把织女留在身边，牛郎就拿走了能让织女飞回天上的衣服。后来，因为牛郎很温柔、很体贴，织女就慢慢爱上他了，最后他们成了夫妇，还生了两个宝贝。
paragraphs.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng a! Wèile bǎ Zhīnǚ liú zài shēnbiān, Niúláng jiù názǒu le néng ràng Zhīnǚ fēi huí tiānshàng de yīfú. Hòulái, yīnwèi Niúláng hěn wēnróu, hěn tǐtiē, Zhīnǚ jiù mànmàn àishàng tā le, zuìhòu tāmen chéng le fūfù, hái shēng le liǎng ge bǎobèi.
paragraphs.english: Of course he did! To keep Weaver Girl by his side, Niulang took away the clothes that allowed her to fly back to heaven. Later, because Niulang was gentle and thoughtful, Weaver Girl gradually fell in love with him, and eventually they became husband and wife and had two precious children.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 他們就這樣過著幸福快樂的日子嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 他们就这样过着幸福快乐的日子吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Tāmen jiù zhèyàng guò zhe xìngfú kuàilè de rìzi ma?
paragraphs.english: And did they live happily ever after just like that?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 唉，沒那麼簡單。天帝知道了以後，氣得叫王母娘娘把織女抓回天上，還把她關了起來。牛郎找來找去，總算在天上某個神祕的地方找到了織女。沒想到王母娘娘卻在他們中間變出一條銀河，讓他們只能遠遠地看著對方。
paragraphs.simplified: 唉，没那么简单。天帝知道了以后，气得叫王母娘娘把织女抓回天上，还把她关了起来。牛郎找来找去，总算在天上某个神秘的地方找到了织女。没想到王母娘娘却在他们中间变出一条银河，让他们只能远远地看着对方。
paragraphs.pinyin: Ài, méi nàme jiǎndān. Tiāndì zhīdào le yǐhòu, qì de jiào Wángmǔ Niángniang bǎ Zhīnǚ zhuā huí tiānshàng, hái bǎ tā guān le qǐlái. Niúláng zhǎoláizhǎoqù, zǒngsuàn zài tiānshàng mǒu ge shénmì de dìfāng zhǎodào le Zhīnǚ. Méi xiǎngdào Wángmǔ Niángniang què zài tāmen zhōngjiān biànchū yì tiáo Yínhé, ràng tāmen zhǐ néng yuǎnyuǎn de kàn zhe duìfāng.
paragraphs.english: Alas, it wasn't so simple. When the Heavenly Emperor found out, he was furious and ordered the Queen Mother of the West to drag Weaver Girl back to heaven and lock her up. Niulang searched everywhere and finally found Weaver Girl in a mysterious place in heaven. Unexpectedly, the Queen Mother conjured up the Milky Way between them, allowing them only to gaze at each other from afar.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 織女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人間住下去，真可憐。
paragraphs.simplified: 织女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人间住下去，真可怜。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhīnǚ bù néng gēn Niúláng jù zài yìqǐ, yě bù néng zài rénjiān zhù xiàqù, zhēn kělián.
paragraphs.english: Weaver Girl couldn't be together with Niulang, nor could she live on in the mortal world; how pitiful.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 還好姊姊們很同情她，好幾次請求王母娘娘幫忙。王母娘娘仔細觀察了兩人的情況，終於被他們的愛情感動了，答應讓他們在每年的農曆七月初七見面。有人說，七夕年年都會下雨，那就是織女流下的眼淚。
paragraphs.simplified: 还好姐姐们很同情她，好几次请求王母娘娘帮忙。王母娘娘仔细观察了两人的情况，终于被他们的爱情感动了，答应让他们在每年的农历七月初七见面。有人说，七夕年年都会下雨，那就是织女流下的眼泪。
paragraphs.pinyin: Háihǎo jiějiěmen hěn tóngqíng tā, hǎojǐ cì qǐngqiú Wángmǔ Niángniang bāngmáng. Wángmǔ Niángniang zǐxì guānchá le liǎng rén de qíngkuàng, zhōngyú bèi tāmen de àiqíng gǎndòng le, dāyìng ràng tāmen zài měinián de nónglì qīyuè chū qī jiànmiàn. Yǒu rén shuō, Qīxī niánnián dōu huì xiàyǔ, nà jiùshì Zhīnǚ liúxià de yǎnlèi.
paragraphs.english: Fortunately her sisters sympathized with her and begged the Queen Mother repeatedly for help. The Queen Mother closely observed the couple's devotion and was finally moved by their love, granting them permission to meet every year on the seventh day of the seventh lunar month. Some say that it rains every year on Qixi, and that is Weaver Girl shedding tears.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 幸虧有姊姊們的幫助，要不然他們一生都不能團圓了。
paragraphs.simplified: 幸亏有姐姐们的帮助，要不然他们一生都不能团圆了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu jiějiěmen de bāngzhù, yàobùrán tāmen yìshēng dōu bù néng tuányuán le.
paragraphs.english: Fortunately they had the sisters' help, otherwise they would never have reunited in their entire lives.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 可是一年只能見一次面，這樣的結局讓我很難過。
paragraphs.simplified: 可是一年只能见一次面，这样的结局让我很难过。
paragraphs.pinyin: Kěshì yì nián zhǐ néng jiàn yí cì miàn, zhèyàng de jiéjú ràng wǒ hěn nánguò.
paragraphs.english: But meeting only once a year—such an ending makes me sad.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 怎麼說呢？
paragraphs.simplified: 怎么说呢？
paragraphs.pinyin: Zěnme shuō ne?
paragraphs.english: Why do you say that?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 我女朋友畢業後就要出國念書，我擔心兩個人分開太久，關係就變淡了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我女朋友毕业后就要出国念书，我担心两个人分开太久，关系就变淡了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ nǚpéngyǒu bìyè hòu jiù yào chūguó niànshū, wǒ dānxīn liǎng ge rén fēnkāi tài jiǔ, guānxì jiù biàn dàn le.
paragraphs.english: My girlfriend is going abroad to study after graduation. I worry that being apart too long will cause our relationship to fade.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 別擔心，現在網路這麼方便，隨時都能聊天、傳照片，距離再遠也沒問題。
paragraphs.simplified: 别担心，现在网络这么方便，随时都能聊天、传照片，距离再远也没问题。
paragraphs.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, xiànzài wǎnglù zhème fāngbiàn, suíshí dōu néng liáotiān, chuán zhàopiàn, jùlí zài yuǎn yě méi wèntí.
paragraphs.english: Don't worry. The internet is so convenient now; you can chat and send photos anytime. No matter how far the distance, it won't be a problem.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 沒問題倒是沒問題，不過遠距離的戀愛還是很辛苦的。
paragraphs.simplified: 没问题倒是没问题，不过远距离的恋爱还是很辛苦的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Méi wèntí dàoshì méi wèntí, bùguò yuǎnjùlí de liàn'ài háishì hěn xīnkǔ de.
paragraphs.english: No problem is true enough, but a long-distance relationship is still very tough.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 別想那麼多了，你還是說說跟七夕有關的習俗吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 别想那么多了，你还是说说跟七夕有关的习俗吧。
paragraphs.pinyin: Bié xiǎng nàme duō le, nǐ háishì shuōshuo gēn Qīxī yǒuguān de xísú ba.
paragraphs.english: Don't overthink it; why not tell me about customs related to Qixi instead?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 好吧。七夕那天，當月亮升起時，就會有拜織女的活動。因為織女織布的技巧很好，能織出漂亮的衣服和美麗的雲。人間的姑娘希望能像她那樣又聰明又漂亮，就會用一些親手做的東西來拜她。
paragraphs.simplified: 好吧。七夕那天，当月亮升起时，就会有拜织女的活动。因为织女织布的技巧很好，能织出漂亮的衣服和美丽的云。人间的小姑娘希望能像她那样又聪明又漂亮，就会用一些亲手做的小东西来拜她。
paragraphs.pinyin: Hǎoba. Qīxī nà tiān, dāng yuèliàng shēngqǐ shí, jiù huì yǒu bài Zhīnǚ de huódòng. Yīnwèi Zhīnǚ zhībù de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, néng zhīchū piàoliang de yīfú hé měilì de yún. Rénjiān de gūniáng xīwàng néng xiàng tā nàyàng yòu cōngmíng yòu piàoliang, jiù huì yòng yìxiē qīnshǒu zuò de xiǎo dōngxī lái bài tā.
paragraphs.english: All right. On Qixi day, when the moon rises, there are activities honoring Weaver Girl. Because Weaver Girl's weaving skill was superb, able to weave beautiful clothes and splendid clouds. Girls in the mortal world hoping to be clever and lovely like her would worship her with handmade items.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 你女朋友在七夕送你這個親手做的錢包，原來有特別的意義啊！
paragraphs.simplified: 你女朋友在七夕送你这个亲手做的钱包，原来有特别的意义啊！
paragraphs.pinyin: Nǐ nǚpéngyǒu zài Qīxī sòng nǐ zhège qīnshǒu zuò de qiánbāo, yuánlái yǒu tèbié de yìyì a!
paragraphs.english: So your girlfriend giving you this handmade wallet on Qixi carries a special meaning after all!

items.title: 短文 · 情人節的意義
items.titleEnglish: Reading · The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 根據中國古代的說法，農曆七月初七是所謂的「七夕」。一提到七夕，人們就會想到牛郎和織女的愛情故事。這個故事不是真的，不過大家對愛情還是有無窮的想像，希望在現實中能夠擁有最美好的愛情。
paragraphs.simplified: 根据中国古代的说法，农历七月初七是所谓的「七夕」。一提到七夕，人们就会想到牛郎和织女的爱情故事。这个故事不是真的，不过大家对爱情还是有无穷的想象，希望在现实中能够拥有最美好的爱情。
paragraphs.pinyin: Gēnjù Zhōngguó gǔdài de shuōfǎ, nónglì qīyuè chū qī shì suǒwèi de "Qīxī". Yì tídào Qīxī, rénmen jiù huì xiǎngdào Niúláng hé Zhīnǚ de àiqíng gùshì. Zhège gùshì búshì zhēn de, bùguò dàjiā duì àiqíng háishì yǒu wúqióng de xiǎngxiàng, xīwàng zài xiànshí zhōng nénggòu yǒngyǒu zuì měihǎo de àiqíng.
paragraphs.english: According to ancient Chinese accounts, the seventh day of the seventh lunar month is known as "Qixi". Whenever Qixi is mentioned, people think of the love story of Niulang and Weaver Girl. While this tale is not true, people still harbor boundless imagination for romance, hoping to possess the finest love in reality.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 按照過去的習俗，姑娘會在七夕把親手做的小東西送給朋友，向對方表達心意。後來，商人抓到了這個能創造更多利益的機會，就在七夕和西方情人節這兩個節日，推銷屬於情人節的特別禮物。不僅戀愛中的男女願意花錢買，平時只有以網路聊天、寫信等方式談戀愛的情侶，也會在這天送禮。但是某一些商業廣告強調，情人節交換禮物是愛對方的表現，也是情侶之間該有的責任。讓很多人以為不送禮、不約會是個錯誤，而犯了錯的人就得道歉。其實只要對情人是真心的，送不送禮物沒那麼重要，畢竟單純的愛情才是最珍貴的。
paragraphs.simplified: 按照过去的习俗，姑娘会在七夕把亲手做的小东西送给朋友，向对方表达心意。后来，商人抓到了这个能创造更多利益的机会，就在七夕和西方情人节这两个节日，推销属于情人节的特别礼物。不仅恋爱中的男女愿意花钱买，平时只有以网络聊天、写信等方式谈恋爱的情侣，也会在这天送礼。但是某一些商业广告强调，情人节交换礼物是爱对方的表现，也是情侣之间该有的责任。让很多人以为不送礼、不约会是个错误，而犯了错的人就得道歉。其实只要对情人是真心的，送不送礼物没那么重要，毕竟单纯的爱情才是最珍贵的。
paragraphs.pinyin: Ànzhào guòqù de xísú, gūniáng huì zài Qīxī bǎ qīnshǒu zuò de xiǎo dōngxī sòng gěi péngyǒu, xiàng duìfāng biǎodá xīnyì. Hòulái, shāngrén zhuādào le zhège néng chuàngzào gèng duō lìyì de jīhuì, jiù zài Qīxī hé xīfāng Qíngrénjié zhè liǎng ge jiérì, tuīxiāo shǔyú Qíngrénjié de tèbié lǐwù. Bùjǐn liàn'ài zhōng de nánnǚ yuànyì huāqián mǎi, píngshí zhǐyǒu yǐ wǎnglù liáotiān, xiěxìn děng fāngshì tán liàn'ài de qínglǚ, yě huì zài zhè tiān sònglǐ. Dànshì mǒu yìxiē shāngyè guǎnggào qiángdiào, Qíngrénjié jiāohuàn lǐwù shì ài duìfāng de biǎoxiàn, yě shì qínglǚ zhījiān gāi yǒu de zérèn. Ràng hěn duō rén yǐwéi bú sònglǐ, bú yuēhuì shì ge cuòwù, ér fàn le cuò de rén jiù děi dàoqiàn. Qíshí zhǐyào duì qíngrén shì zhēnxīn de, sòng bu sòng lǐwù méi nàme zhòngyào, bìjìng dānchún de àiqíng cái shì zuì zhēnguì de.
paragraphs.english: According to past customs, young maidens would give handmade trinkets to friends on Qixi to express their affection. Later, merchants seized upon this opportunity to create greater profits, promoting special Valentine gifts during both Qixi and Western Valentine's Day. Not only were courting couples eager to spend money, but long-distance lovers who usually interacted only by online chatting and letters would also send gifts on this day. However, certain commercial advertisements emphasized that exchanging gifts on Valentine's Day proves one's love and is an obligation between lovers. This led many to believe that not giving gifts or going on dates is a misstep requiring an apology. In reality, as long as one is sincere toward their beloved, whether gifts are given is not so critical—after all, pure love is what is truly precious.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 不過話說回來，像牛郎與織女這樣的愛情故事，還是感動了無數人。不少文學與戲劇都採用這類的題材，畫家也常透過作品來表達浪漫的愛情。如能花點時間欣賞這方面的作品，或許就能更深入了解情人節的意義了。
paragraphs.simplified: 不过话说回来，像牛郎与织女这样的爱情故事，还是感动了无数人。不少文学与戏剧都采用这类的题材，画家也常透过作品来表达浪漫的爱情。如能花点时间欣赏这方面的作品，或许就能更深入了解情人节的意义了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Bùguò huàshuōhuílái, xiàng Niúláng yǔ Zhīnǚ zhèyàng de àiqíng gùshì, háishì gǎndòng le wúshù rén. Bùshǎo wénxué yǔ xìjù dōu cǎiyòng zhè lèi de tícái, huàjiā yě cháng tòuguò zuòpǐn lái biǎodá làngmàn de àiqíng. Rú néng huā diǎn shíjiān xīnshǎng zhè fāngmiàn de zuòpǐn, huòxǔ jiù néng gèng shēnrù liǎojiě Qíngrénjié de yìyì le.
paragraphs.english: Then again, love stories like Niulang and Weaver Girl still touch countless hearts. Many literary works and dramas adopt themes of this kind, and painters frequently convey romantic love through their art. If one can take some time to appreciate works in this domain, perhaps one will gain a deeper understanding of Valentine's true meaning.
